asana.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
asana.description: Dr. Weil's relaxing breath.
asana.instructions: Inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8. 4 rounds 2× daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: 5Rhythms Dance
asana.description: Gabrielle Roth's 5 rhythms practice.
asana.instructions: Dance through 5 rhythms: flowing, staccato, chaos, lyrical, stillness. 1–2 hours.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Trauma-sensitive.

asana.name: Abhaya Mudra
asana.description: Fearlessness gesture — right hand raised, palm out.
asana.instructions: Stand or sit, right hand raised to shoulder height, palm forward. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Aboriginal Dadirri
asana.description: Aboriginal Australian deep listening.
asana.instructions: Sit silently in nature, listen deeply. 20+ min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Acro Plank
asana.description: Base on back, flyer in plank on base's feet.
asana.instructions: Base lies back, feet on flyer's shoulders/hips, flyer in plank. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/wrist injury. Use spotter.

asana.name: Acro Star
asana.description: Base lifts flyer into star shape on feet.
asana.instructions: Base on back, feet on flyer's hips/shoulders, lifts flyer into star (arms and legs spread). Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Advanced. Use spotter. Avoid in shoulder/wrist injury.

asana.name: Acro Throne
asana.description: Base sitting, flyer standing on base's thighs.
asana.instructions: Base sits knees bent, flyer stands on base's thighs holding hands. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use spotter.

asana.name: Acro Whale
asana.description: Flyer in backbend on base's feet.
asana.instructions: Base on back, feet on flyer's upper back, lifts flyer into backbend. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Advanced. Use spotter. Avoid in back injury.
benefits: Deep backbend for flyer, strengthens base.

asana.name: Aerial Bow
asana.description: Bow pose supported in hammock.
asana.instructions: Lie prone in hammock, hold ankles, lift chest and legs. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Aerial Cobra
asana.description: Cobra pose using hammock for support.
asana.instructions: Lie face-down in hammock, lift chest using hammock support. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, high BP, pregnancy. Use certified instructor.
benefits: Supported backbend, opens chest, decompresses spine.

asana.name: Aerial Cocoon
asana.description: Wrapped pose in hammock like cocoon.
asana.instructions: Wrap entire body in hammock, eyes closed. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use instructor for safe wrapping.

asana.name: Aerial Down Dog
asana.description: Down dog with hips supported by hammock.
asana.instructions: Place hammock under hips, walk hands forward, lift into down dog. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, high BP, wrist injury.

asana.name: Aerial Flip
asana.description: Advanced flip in hammock.
asana.instructions: From seated in hammock, flip forward to inverted position. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Avoid without qualified instructor. Glaucoma, high BP, pregnancy.

asana.name: Aerial Forward Fold
asana.description: Forward fold with hammock support.
asana.instructions: Stand with hammock under hips, fold forward. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP. Rise slowly.

asana.name: Aerial Heart Opener
asana.description: Backbend with back arched over hammock.
asana.instructions: Sit in hammock, lean back, arms out, arch over. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, pregnancy. Use instructor.

asana.name: Aerial Pigeon
asana.description: Pigeon pose in hammock.
asana.instructions: From hammock, place one leg in figure-4, fold forward. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip/knee injury. Use instructor.

asana.name: Aerial Plank
asana.description: Plank pose with feet in hammock.
asana.instructions: From hands on floor, feet in hammock, body straight. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Aerial Savasana
asana.description: Relaxation pose in hammock.
asana.instructions: Lie back in hammock, arms and legs relaxed. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use instructor for setup.

asana.name: Aerial Spider
asana.description: Spider pose in hammock with legs in hammock, hands on floor.
asana.instructions: Feet in hammock, hands on floor, hips lifted. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Aerial Star Inversion
asana.description: Inverted star pose in hammock.
asana.instructions: Invert in hammock, legs and arms spread wide. Hold 30 sec–1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, high BP. Use instructor.

asana.name: Aerial Straddle
asana.description: Straddle pose with legs wide in hammock.
asana.instructions: Sit in hammock, legs straddle wide. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury.

asana.name: Aerial Twist
asana.description: Seated twist in hammock.
asana.instructions: Sit in hammock, twist right, hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury.

asana.name: Aerial inversion
asana.description: Full inversion in hammock.
asana.instructions: Wrap hammock around sacrum, flip upside down. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, high BP, pregnancy, recent surgery. Use instructor.

asana.name: Agni Sara
asana.description: Fire essence — abdominal fluttering on exhale hold.
asana.instructions: Exhale fully, flutter abdomen in and out rapidly while holding breath. 10–20 flutters, 3 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, hernia. Empty stomach only.
benefits: Stimulates digestion fire, tones abdomen, traditional.

asana.name: Aikido Breakfall
asana.description: Aikido breakfall technique.
asana.instructions: From height, slap mat while falling. 5 reps.
asana.precautions: Learn under teacher. Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Aikido Roll Backward
asana.description: Aikido backward roll.
asana.instructions: From standing, roll backward over shoulder to feet. 5–10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Aikido Roll Forward
asana.description: Aikido forward roll.
asana.instructions: From standing, roll forward over shoulder to feet. 5–10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Akasha Mudra
asana.description: Space mudra — thumb touching middle finger.
asana.instructions: Touch thumb to middle fingertip, others extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms, opens space element, traditional for emptiness.

asana.name: Alexander Hands Behind Back
asana.description: Alexander posture with hands behind back.
asana.instructions: Stand, clasp hands behind back, lift chest. 1 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alexander Lunge
asana.description: Alexander lunge for movement.
asana.instructions: Step forward in lunge, arms free. 5 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alexander Monkey
asana.description: Alexander 'monkey' position for posture.
asana.instructions: Stand with hip hinge, knees bent, spine long. 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Alexander Semi-Supine
asana.description: Alexander technique semi-supine rest.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, knees bent, feet flat, head on books. 15–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alexander Sitting
asana.description: Alexander sitting technique.
asana.instructions: Sit on chair, feet flat, spine long, balanced. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alexander Squatting
asana.description: Alexander squat technique.
asana.instructions: Squat with heels down, spine long. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Alexander Stair Climbing
asana.description: Alexander stair technique.
asana.instructions: Climb stairs with awareness. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alexander Walking
asana.description: Alexander walking technique.
asana.instructions: Walk with awareness of head-neck-back. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alexander Whispered 'Ah'
asana.description: Alexander technique breath exercise.
asana.instructions: Inhale, exhale with whispered 'ah'. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Alternate Nostril Breathing
asana.description: Balancing breath practice alternating nostrils with finger guidance.
asana.instructions: Sit comfortably, right thumb closes right nostril, inhale left; ring finger closes left, exhale right; inhale right; close, exhale left. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe nasal congestion (do after steam). Don't force breath; gentle and slow.
benefits: Balances breath rhythm and calms autonomic arousal

asana.name: Anahatasana
asana.description: Puppy pose held long for heart opening.
asana.instructions: From table-top, walk hands forward, chest toward floor. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury. Use bolster under chest.

asana.name: Anjali Mudra
asana.description: Prayer position — palms together at heart.
asana.instructions: Stand or sit, palms together at heart, elbows out. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Anjaneyasana
asana.description: Low lunge with back knee down, arms overhead or forward.
asana.instructions: From down-dog, step right foot forward, lower back knee, lift arms overhead. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury (use blanket under back knee). Modify hands on front thigh.
benefits: Stretches hip flexors, opens chest, prepares for backbends.

asana.name: Anuloma Pranayama
asana.description: Inhale through both nostrils, exhale through alternate.
asana.instructions: Inhale through both nostrils, exhale through one (alternate). 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe nasal congestion.

asana.name: Apana Mudra
asana.description: Downward-energy mudra — thumb touching middle and ring.
asana.instructions: Touch thumb to middle and ring fingertips, others extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Apana Vayu Mudra
asana.description: Heart-saving mudra — index to thumb, middle and ring to thumb.
asana.instructions: Fold index finger to thumb, touch middle and ring to thumb, pinky extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't replace medical care for cardiac conditions.

asana.name: Apanasana Flow
asana.description: Wind-relieving pose flow with both knees alternately.
asana.instructions: From supine, alternate drawing right and left knee to chest, gently rocking. Flow 1–2 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy (after 1st trimester).
benefits: Aids digestion, releases lower back, calming.

asana.name: Apparent Closure
asana.description: Tai chi closing posture.
asana.instructions: Step and shift weight, hands close. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Arch Body Hold
asana.description: Gymnastics back extension hold.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, lift chest, arms, legs. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Asana Practice
asana.description: Third limb — physical postures.
asana.instructions: Practice asanas regularly to prepare for seated meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Astavakrasana Variations
asana.description: Eight-angle pose variations.
asana.instructions: Various Eight-Angle Pose variations.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Aswini Mudra
asana.description: Horse gesture — anal sphincter contraction.
asana.instructions: Sit, contract and release anal sphincter in rhythm. 10–20 contractions.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't over-tighten.
benefits: Strengthens pelvic floor, traditional for awakening energy.

asana.name: Authentic Movement
asana.description: Movement therapy with eyes closed.
asana.instructions: Move with eyes closed, witness by partner. 30–60 min.
asana.precautions: Trauma-sensitive. Work with therapist.

asana.name: Baby Crow
asana.description: Crow on forearms — easier on wrists.
asana.instructions: From squat, forearms on floor, knees onto upper arms, lift feet. Hold 10–20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/elbow injury.
benefits: Builds arm balance strength, easier on wrists than full Crow.

asana.name: Back Kick
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Back Kick (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Back Kick (Karate): Look back, chamber knee, extend heel backward. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Back Stance
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Back Stance (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Back Stance (Karate): Step back, weight on back leg, front leg straight. Hold 30 sec each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: leg strength Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.name: Ballet Arabesque
asana.description: Ballet arabesque — leg extended back.
asana.instructions: Stand on one leg, extend other back horizontally. Hold 30 sec each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Ballet Attitude
asana.description: Ballet attitude — leg bent back.
asana.instructions: Stand on one leg, other leg bent behind. Hold 30 sec each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury.

asana.name: Ballet Dégagé
asana.description: Ballet dégagé — foot lifting off floor.
asana.instructions: Slide foot, lift slightly off floor. 10 reps each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Ballet Développé
asana.description: Ballet développé — extending leg.
asana.instructions: Draw knee up, extend leg to front/side/back. Hold 5 sec each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury.

asana.name: Ballet Grand Battement
asana.description: Ballet grand battement — high leg kick.
asana.instructions: Kick leg high to front/side/back. 10 reps each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury. Warm up first.

asana.name: Ballet Pirouette
asana.description: Ballet turn on one leg.
asana.instructions: From passé, turn on supporting leg. 5 turns each direction.
asana.precautions: Avoid in ankle injury.

asana.name: Ballet Plié
asana.description: Ballet plié — bending of knees.
asana.instructions: Stand turned out, bend knees, keep chest up. 10 reps each position.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Turn out from hips.

asana.name: Ballet Port de Bras
asana.description: Ballet port de bras — arm movements.
asana.instructions: Move arms through positions. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Ballet Rond de Jambe
asana.description: Ballet rond de jambe — circling leg.
asana.instructions: Circle leg from front to side to back. 5 reps each direction.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury.

asana.name: Ballet Tendu
asana.description: Ballet tendu — foot sliding.
asana.instructions: Slide foot forward/side/back along floor. 10 reps each direction.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Banana
asana.description: Supine side-bend with legs and arms shifted to one side.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, shift legs and arms to one side, body in banana shape. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/hip injury. Use pillow under head.
benefits: Stretches entire side body, opens intercostal muscles.

asana.name: Basti
asana.description: Colon cleansing techniques — traditional yogic enema.
asana.instructions: Traditionally: sit in water, draw water into colon via Uddiyana/Nauli. Modern: enema alternative.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision. Don't replace medical care.
benefits: Cleanses colon, traditional for Vata disorders.

asana.name: Bear Crawl
asana.description: Quadrupedal crawling exercise.
asana.instructions: Crawl forward on hands and feet, opposite arm-leg. 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Bedtime Sun Salutation
asana.description: Gentle floor-based sun salutation for sleep.
asana.instructions: Modified sun salutation lying/sitting, gentle stretches. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Bee Breath
asana.description: Humming exhalation producing a bee-like vibration.
asana.instructions: Sit tall, close ears with thumbs, fingers over eyes, inhale through nose, exhale with humming sound. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe ear infection. Practice on empty stomach. Best before sleep.
benefits: Calms mind, relieves anxiety & tension headaches, improves sleep, lowers BP.

asana.name: Bellows Breath
asana.description: Forceful inhales and exhales through nose like a blacksmith's bellows.
asana.instructions: Sit tall, forceful inhale and exhale through nose, 1 per sec, 10–20 breaths, then rest. Repeat 3 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, heart disease, pregnancy, epilepsy, vertigo. Stop if dizzy.
benefits: Energizes, increases oxygen, clears mind, builds heat.

asana.name: Bhairava Mudra
asana.description: Hand mudra — right hand on left, palms up.
asana.instructions: Sit, right hand over left in lap, palms up. Hold during meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Bhairavi Mudra
asana.description: Hand mudra — left hand on right, palms up.
asana.instructions: Sit, left hand over right in lap, palms up. Hold during meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Bhastrika Variations
asana.description: Bellows breath variations — fast, medium, slow.
asana.instructions: Try slow Bhastrika (1 breath/2 sec), medium (1/sec), fast (2/sec).
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, heart disease, pregnancy, epilepsy.

asana.name: Bhramari Variations
asana.description: Bee breath with different mudras and pitches.
asana.instructions: Try Bhramari with different mudras (Shanmukhi, Jnana) and pitches. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Different effects — low pitch calms, high pitch energizes.

asana.name: Bhujapidasana
asana.description: Body lifted on hands, thighs pressing shoulders.
asana.instructions: From wide forward fold, place hands, thread legs over arms, cross ankles, lift. Hold 10–20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Bird Dog
asana.description: Functional core stabilization.
asana.instructions: From table-top, extend opposite arm and leg. 10 each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Bird-Dog
asana.description: Tabletop with opposite arm and leg extended.
asana.instructions: From tabletop, extend right arm forward, left leg back, body straight. Hold 15 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury. Modify with smaller movements.
benefits: Strengthens core, improves balance, stabilizes spine.

asana.name: Birth Breath Practice
asana.description: Breath practice for labor.
asana.instructions: Sit, practice slow deep breaths, then panting breath (hee-hee-hoo). 5 min daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn from childbirth educator.

asana.name: Boat Pose
asana.description: V-shape balancing pose on sitting bones, legs and arms extended.
asana.instructions: Sit, lean back slightly, lift legs to 45°, arms forward parallel to floor, spine long. Hold 20–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low back injury, hernia, recent abdominal surgery, pregnancy. Bend knees to modify.

asana.name: Boat Pose Variations
asana.description: Boat pose with legs lower (low boat) or twisting.
asana.instructions: From Boat, lower legs and torso (Low Boat), or twist side to side. Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Body Scan Meditation
asana.description: Systematic body awareness.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, scan body from feet to head, observe sensations. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Trauma-sensitive modifications.

asana.name: Bone Marrow Washing
asana.description: Advanced qigong by Bodhidharma.
asana.instructions: Visualization with breath, 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Advanced. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Bound Angle
asana.description: Hip opener with soles together.
asana.instructions: Sit, soles together, knees out, hands on knees. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use blocks under thighs if hips tight.

asana.name: Bound Angle Pose
asana.description: Butterfly pose — soles together, knees out to sides.
asana.instructions: Sit, bend knees, soles together, draw heels toward pelvis. Hold feet, lengthen spine. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee or groin injury (use blocks under thighs). Sit on elevation if hips tight.
benefits: Opens hips & groins, stimulates abdominal organs & kidneys, supports prostate & bladder, relieves menstrual discomfort.

asana.name: Bow Pose
asana.description: Bow-shaped prone backbend holding ankles, lifting chest & thighs.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, bend knees, reach back and hold ankles, kick legs back to lift chest & thighs. Hold 15–30 sec, repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/neck injury, hernia, recent abdominal surgery, pregnancy, high BP.
benefits: Strengthens spine & back muscles, opens chest & shoulders, stimulates digestion, improves posture.

asana.name: Box Breathing
asana.description: Box breathing — inhale, hold, exhale, hold — all equal counts.
asana.instructions: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms nervous system, used by Navy SEALs for stress.

asana.name: Breath of Fire
asana.description: Fast-paced abdominal breath (Kundalini tradition).
asana.instructions: Sit, rapid inhale-exhale through nose (2–3 per sec), pumping navel. 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, vertigo, recent abdominal surgery.
benefits: Energizes, oxygenates, releases tension, Kundalini tradition.

asana.name: Bridge Pose
asana.description: Supine backbend — body lifted from shoulders to knees.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, knees bent, feet hip-width, press feet, lift hips toward ceiling, interlace hands under back. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury (don't turn head while lifted). Use block under sacrum for supported version.
contraindications: Neck injury — avoid neck rotation in pose
Late pregnancy — practice supported bridge with block
benefits: Opens chest and counteracts kyphotic sitting
Gentle backbend suitable for desk workers

asana.name: Bridge with Bind
asana.description: Bridge with hands clasped under back, lifting higher.
asana.instructions: From Bridge, interlace hands under back, lift higher. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/neck injury.

asana.name: Brush Knee Twist Step
asana.description: Tai chi movement; stepping with brush and push.
asana.instructions: Step forward, push with one hand, brush with other. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Buddhi Mudra
asana.description: Intellect mudra — thumb touching pinky.
asana.instructions: Touch thumb to pinky fingertip, others extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Burpee
asana.description: Full-body cardio exercise.
asana.instructions: From standing, drop to plank, push-up, jump feet, jump up. 5–10 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/wrist injury.

asana.name: Buteyko Breathing
asana.description: Buteyko reduced breathing for asthma.
asana.instructions: Practice reduced breathing, breath holds. Daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't strain.

asana.name: Butterfly
asana.description: Seated wide-leg forward fold with feet together.
asana.instructions: Sit, soles together far from body, fold forward rounding spine. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury. Use bolster under torso.
benefits: Stretches inner thighs, lower back, opens hips — Yin style holds 3–5 min.

asana.name: Camel Pose
asana.description: Deep kneeling backbend reaching for heels.
asana.instructions: Kneel knees hip-width, hands on lower back, lift chest, lean back, reach for heels. Hold 20–30 sec, repeat 2×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury, high/low BP, migraine. Keep neck neutral or chin to chest if sensitive.
benefits: Opens entire front body, strengthens spine, improves posture, lifts mood, stimulates digestion.

asana.name: Camel with Bind
asana.description: Camel pose with one hand to heel, other arm extended.
asana.instructions: From Camel, one hand to heel, other arm overhead. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/neck injury.

asana.name: Cat Stance
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Cat Stance (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Cat Stance (Karate): Stand with weight on back leg, front heel up. Hold 30 sec each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Cat-Cow
asana.description: Gentle spinal mobility flow on hands and knees.
asana.instructions: From table-top, inhale drop belly (Cow), exhale round spine (Cat). Flow 1–2 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Widen knees for belly comfort.
benefits: Eases back pain, prepares body, baby-friendly.

asana.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
asana.description: Spinal mobility flow alternating between arching (cow) and rounding (cat) the back.
asana.instructions: From table-top, inhale drop belly lift chest (Cow), exhale round spine tuck chin (Cat). Flow 1–2 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist injury (use fists), neck injury (keep neck neutral).
benefits: Warms spine, releases tension, improves posture, connects breath with movement.

asana.name: Caterpillar
asana.description: Seated forward fold with legs extended.
asana.instructions: Sit legs extended, round forward over legs, hands on shins. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury. Bend knees if needed.
