asana.description: Squat-like standing pose — like sitting in an imaginary chair.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, raise arms overhead, exhale bend knees, lower hips as if sitting back. Keep lower back long. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, knee injury, shoulder injury (arms parallel to floor), insomnia.

asana.name: Chair Sun Salutation
asana.description: Sun salutation seated in chair.
asana.instructions: Modified sun salutation seated — arm raises, side bends, twists. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe for all levels.

asana.name: Chakra Meditation
asana.description: Focus on each of 7 chakras.
asana.instructions: Sit, focus on each chakra from root to crown, visualize color/sound. 20–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn under teacher for depth.

asana.name: Chakras
asana.description: Seven energy centers.
asana.instructions: Contemplate seven chakras from root to crown.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Child's Pose
asana.description: Kneeling forward fold with arms forward or back — resting pose.
asana.instructions: From kneeling, knees wide, big toes touching, fold torso forward, forehead to floor/mat, arms forward or beside body. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury, diarrhea, pregnancy (widen knees). Use bolster under torso if needed.
benefits: Calms brain, relieves stress & fatigue, gently stretches hips, thighs, ankles

asana.name: Child’s Pose
asana.description: Kneeling forward fold with arms forward or back — resting pose.
asana.instructions: From kneeling, knees wide, big toes touching, fold torso forward, forehead to floor/mat, arms forward or beside body. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury, diarrhea, pregnancy (widen knees). Use bolster under torso if needed.
contraindications: Knee injury — place blanket behind knees
Late pregnancy — wide knees, avoid pressure on abdomen
benefits: Resting posture that releases the lower back
Calms breath and mind between sequences

asana.name: Chin Mudra
asana.description: Hand gesture — thumb and index finger touching, others extended.
asana.instructions: Sit, hands on knees, thumb and index finger touch, other fingers extended. Hold during meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms mind, enhances meditation, symbolizes consciousness.

asana.name: Christian Centering Prayer
asana.description: Christian contemplative prayer.
asana.instructions: Sit silently, return to sacred word when distracted. 20 min 2×/day.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Classical Surya Namaskara
asana.description: Traditional 12-posture Hatha sun salutation.
asana.instructions: Pranamasana → Hasta Padasana → Ashwa Sanchalanasana → Dandasana → Ashtanga Namaskara → Bhujangasana → Parvatasana → Ashwa Sanchalanasana → Hasta Padasana → Pranamasana. 12 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for knee/wrist.

asana.name: Cloud Hands
asana.description: Iconic tai chi movement — slow hand sweep.
asana.instructions: Slow weight shifts with hand sweep, 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Cobra Pose
asana.description: Gentle prone backbend with chest lifted, like a cobra's hood.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, palms under shoulders, press pelvis down, lift chest by engaging back muscles, soften shoulders. Hold 15–30 sec, repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, back injury, carpal tunnel, recent abdominal surgery.
contraindications: Acute disc herniation or spinal nerve compression
Carpal tunnel syndrome — use forearms (Sphinx variant)
benefits: Opens the chest and counteracts prolonged sitting posture

asana.name: Cobra with Bind
asana.description: Cobra with hands clasped behind back.
asana.instructions: From Cobra, interlace hands behind back, lift chest. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Coherent Breathing
asana.description: 5.5 breaths per minute coherent breathing.
asana.instructions: Breathe 5.5 breaths/min (≈11 sec per breath). 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Compass Pose
asana.description: Seated pose with leg extended overhead.
asana.instructions: From seated, hold right foot, lift leg overhead to side. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/hip/hamstring injury. Advanced — warm up thoroughly.
benefits: Deep hip and shoulder opener, advanced.

asana.name: Conscious Connected Breathing
asana.description: Continuous circular breathing.
asana.instructions: Breathe without pause between inhale and exhale. 30–60 min.
asana.precautions: Work with facilitator. Trauma-sensitive.

asana.name: Constructive Rest
asana.description: Supine with knees bent, feet flat, supported.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, knees bent, feet flat hip-width, arms relaxed. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe for all.

asana.name: Contact Improvisation
asana.description: Partner dance with rolling point of contact.
asana.instructions: Move with partner maintaining contact point. 20 min.
asana.precautions: Learn under teacher. Avoid in joint injury.

asana.name: Contemporary Fall and Recovery
asana.description: Contemporary dance fall and recovery.
asana.instructions: Practice falling and recovering to standing. 10 min.
asana.precautions: Learn under teacher. Avoid in joint injury.

asana.name: Contemporary Floor Work
asana.description: Contemporary dance floor work.
asana.instructions: Move on floor with various patterns. 15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/wrist injury.

asana.name: Cool Down Flow
asana.description: Gentle sequence to cool down after practice.
asana.instructions: Child's pose → Cat-cow → gentle twists → Bridge → Knees-to-chest → Savasana. 10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms, integrates practice, prepares for Savasana.

asana.name: Cooling Breath
asana.description: Cooling breath through rolled tongue.
asana.instructions: Sit, roll tongue into tube, inhale through tongue, exhale through nose. 10–15 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cold weather, respiratory infection. Genetic — some cannot roll tongue.
benefits: Cools body, reduces thirst, calms, lowers BP, useful in summer.

asana.name: Corpse Pose
asana.description: Final relaxation pose — lying flat on back, arms and legs relaxed.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, legs apart, arms slightly away from body palms up, close eyes, breathe naturally. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in late pregnancy (lie on left side), back pain (use bolster under knees). Most accessible pose for all.
contraindications: Late pregnancy — use left side-lying variant
Lower-back discomfort — support knees with bolster
benefits: Structured relaxation closes every practice session
Associated with reduced perceived stress in yoga nidra studies
Supports sleep hygiene when practised at night

asana.name: Corpse Pose with Bolster Under Spine
asana.sanskrit: Corpse Pose with Bolster Under Spine
asana.description: Savasana with bolster along spine.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, bolster along spine, head supported. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Counted Breath
asana.description: Counted inhale-hold-exhale (4-4-4 or 4-7-8).
asana.instructions: Inhale 4 counts, hold 4 counts, exhale 4 counts (or 4-7-8). 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't hold breath beyond comfort.
benefits: Calms, reduces anxiety, improves sleep, focuses mind.

asana.name: Counterbalance Backbend
asana.description: Partners counterbalance by leaning back holding hands.
asana.instructions: Stand facing, hold hands, lean back counterbalancing. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Communicate. Avoid in back injury.
benefits: Opens chest, builds trust, strengthens legs.

asana.name: Cow Face
asana.description: Cow face with deeper hip opening.
asana.instructions: From Cow Face, deeper knee stack. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Cow Face Fold
asana.description: Cow face pose with forward fold.
asana.instructions: From Cow Face, fold forward over stacked knees. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Cow Face Pose
asana.description: Stacked knees with one arm overhead, the other behind the back, hands clasped.
asana.instructions: Stack knees (right over left). Right arm overhead, bend elbow, left arm behind back, clasp fingers. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder, knee, hip injury. Use strap between hands if cannot clasp.
benefits: Opens shoulders & chest, stretches ankles, thighs, hips

asana.name: Crab Walk
asana.description: Reverse quadrupedal crawling.
asana.instructions: Crawl backward, hips lifted. 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Crescent Lunge
asana.description: Lunge with back leg straight, arms overhead.
asana.instructions: From down-dog, step right foot forward, lift back heel, arms overhead. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Modify with back knee down (low lunge).
benefits: Strengthens legs, opens hips, stretches hip flexors, builds focus.

asana.name: Crescent Lunge Twist
asana.description: Crescent lunge with twist, hands in prayer.
asana.instructions: From crescent lunge, hands in prayer, twist right, left elbow outside right knee. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, low BP. Keep gaze forward if neck sensitive.
benefits: Twists spine, opens chest, strengthens legs, stimulates digestion.

asana.name: Crocodile Pose
asana.description: Prone relaxation with arms crossed under forehead.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, arms crossed under forehead, feet apart. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, abdominal surgery.
benefits: Deep abdominal breathing, relaxes back, calms.

asana.name: Cross Hands
asana.description: Tai chi closing posture.
asana.instructions: Stand with crossed hands at chest. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Crow Pose
asana.description: Beginner arm balance — knees on upper arms, body lifted.
asana.instructions: From squat, place palms shoulder-width, knees onto upper arms, shift weight forward, lift feet. Hold 10–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy. Place blanket in front for safety.

asana.name: Dancer Pose
asana.description: Advanced dancer pose with deep backbend.
asana.instructions: From Natarajasana, deepen backbend, foot toward head. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/shoulder/knee injury. Advanced.
benefits: Opens shoulders, strengthens legs, advanced balance.

asana.name: Dangling
asana.description: Standing forward fold held long.
asana.instructions: Stand, fold forward, hands to floor or elbows, hold 2–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, back injury. Bend knees.

asana.name: Deadlift
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Deadlift (Bodyweight).
asana.instructions: From Deadlift (Bodyweight): Hip hinge with flat back, hands to floor. 10–15 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury. Maintain neutral spine. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: Strengthens back, glutes, hamstrings Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.name: Devotional Warrior
asana.description: Warrior I with hands in prayer and forward fold.
asana.instructions: From Warrior I, hands in prayer at heart, fold forward over front leg. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury, balance issues. Use blocks under hands.
benefits: Stretches hips and hamstrings, builds devotion, calms mind.

asana.name: Dharana
asana.description: Sixth limb — concentration.
asana.instructions: Practice single-pointed concentration on object/mantra/breath.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Dhauti
asana.description: Stomach cleansing techniques — various.
asana.instructions: Various techniques: Vastra Dhauti (cloth), Vaman Dhauti (water vomit), etc.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision. Pregnancy, ulcers, hernia.

asana.name: Dhyana
asana.description: Seventh limb — meditation.
asana.instructions: Practice meditation regularly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Dhyana Mudra
asana.description: Meditation mudra — hands in lap, palms up, one on other.
asana.instructions: Sit, hands in lap, right hand on left, palms up, thumbs touching. Hold during meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Deepens meditation, calms, traditional Buddha mudra.

asana.name: Diaphragmatic Breath
asana.description: Belly breathing — focusing on diaphragm movement.
asana.instructions: Lie or sit, hand on belly, inhale belly rises, exhale falls. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe for everyone.
benefits: Calms nervous system, reduces stress, improves digestion, foundational.

asana.name: Differentiating Hips
asana.description: Feldenkrais hip differentiation.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, move legs in different directions. 10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Dolphin Plank
asana.description: Plank on forearms with hips lifted (Dolphin shape).
asana.instructions: From Dolphin, body straight from shoulders to heels on forearms. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury. Modify with knees down.

asana.name: Dolphin Pose
asana.description: Down-dog on forearms — strengthens shoulders.
asana.instructions: From table-top, lower to forearms, lift hips up and back. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, neck injury. Build gradually.

asana.name: Double Down Dog
asana.description: One partner in down dog, other's feet on partner's hips.
asana.instructions: Partner A in down dog. Partner B stands at A's hips, places feet on A's lower back, lifts to L-shape. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/wrist injury. Communicate clearly. Use teacher.
benefits: Decompresses spine, builds trust, inversion benefits.

asana.name: Double Leg Kick
asana.description: Pilates prone double leg kick.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, kick both heels to glutes, lift chest. 6 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Double Leg Stretch
asana.description: Pilates core exercise with both legs.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, draw both knees to chest, extend both. 8 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Downward-Facing Dog
asana.description: Inverted V-shape — hands and feet on floor, hips lifted.
asana.instructions: From hands and knees, tuck toes, lift hips up and back, press palms, lengthen spine, heels toward floor. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist injury, carpal tunnel, high BP, late pregnancy, eye conditions (glaucoma, retinal detachment).
contraindications: Uncontrolled hypertension — avoid sustained head-below-heart positions
Wrist injury or carpal tunnel — use a wall/forearm variant
benefits: Full-body stretch for hamstrings, calves and shoulders

asana.name: Dragon
asana.description: Deep low lunge held long for hip flexor release.
asana.instructions: From low lunge, lower back knee, hands inside front foot. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Use blanket under back knee.
benefits: Stretches hip flexors, quadriceps, opens hips.

asana.name: Dragonfly
asana.description: Dragonfly with deeper split.
asana.instructions: From Dragonfly, deepen split. Hold 5 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Very advanced.

asana.name: Dragonfly Pose
asana.description: Press handstand variation with legs in split.
asana.instructions: From standing, fold, place hands, lift legs into wide straddle. Hold 5–10 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder/hamstring injury. Very advanced — master Crow, Firefly first.

asana.name: Drop-back from Wheel
asana.description: Transitioning from standing to wheel.
asana.instructions: From standing, reach back, lower hands to floor into wheel. Advanced.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/shoulder/wrist injury, pregnancy, high BP. Use teacher.

asana.name: Eagle Pose
asana.description: Balancing pose wrapping legs and arms like an eagle.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, bend knees, wrap right leg over left, hook right foot behind left calf. Wrap right arm under left, hands clasped. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Modify with toe tap instead of full wrap.
benefits: Strengthens legs, opens shoulders, improves balance, stretches upper back.

asana.name: Easy Pose
asana.description: Simple cross-legged meditation posture.
asana.instructions: Sit cross-legged on a folded blanket, hips above knees, spine long, hands on knees. Hold 1–5 min or longer.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury (use elevation, support). Switch cross of legs each session for balance.
benefits: Calms mind, opens hips, lengthens spine, foundation for pranayama and meditation.

asana.name: Eight Brocades
asana.description: Classical Chinese qigong of 8 movements.
asana.instructions: Practice all 8 movements in sequence, 5–10 min daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Eight-Angle Pose
asana.description: Arm balance with legs hooked over one arm, body twisted.
asana.instructions: From seated, hook right leg over right shoulder, cross ankles, place palms, lift hips, twist legs to one side. Hold 10–20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy. Advanced — master Crow and Side Crow first.

asana.name: Elbow Strike
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Elbow Strike (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Elbow Strike (Karate): Strike with elbow in various directions. 10 reps each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: Close-range power Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.name: Elbow Stroke
asana.description: Tai chi elbow movement.
asana.instructions: Step and strike with elbow. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Elephant Trunk
asana.description: Elephant trunk with deeper twist.
asana.instructions: From Elephant Trunk, deepen twist. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Elephant Trunk Pose
asana.description: Legs wrapped around one arm, body twisted.
asana.instructions: From seated, wrap right leg over right shoulder, hook left foot over right, lift hips. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Embrace Tiger Return to Mountain
asana.description: Tai chi movement with hip turn.
asana.instructions: Step and turn, arms embracing. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Extended Child's Pose
asana.description: Child's pose with arms extended far forward.
asana.instructions: From Child's Pose, walk arms forward, forehead to floor. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/shoulder injury.
benefits: Stretches shoulders, lengthens spine, opens chest.

asana.name: Extended Side Angle
asana.description: Side lunge with one hand on floor and the other arm extended overhead.
asana.instructions: From Warrior II, lower front forearm to thigh or hand to floor outside front foot. Top arm extends over ear. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury (gaze forward), knee injury. Modify with forearm on thigh.
benefits: Stretches side body, opens hips & groins, strengthens legs, stimulates abdominal organs.

asana.name: Eye Pillow Savasana
asana.description: Savasana with eye pillow.
asana.instructions: Savasana with eye pillow over closed eyes. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Deepens relaxation, blocks light, calms eyes.

asana.name: Eye-Neck Differentiation
asana.description: Feldenkrais eye-neck differentiation.
asana.instructions: Move eyes and head in different directions. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Fair Lady Works at Shuttles
asana.description: Tai chi shuttle movement with bow stance.
asana.instructions: Step and turn, alternate hands. 4 directions.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Fan Through Back
asana.description: Tai chi opening movement.
asana.instructions: Step and turn, arms open like fan. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Final Savasana with Bolster
asana.description: Final relaxation with bolster under knees.
asana.instructions: Savasana with bolster under knees. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Releases lower back, ends practice with restoration.

asana.name: Firefly Pose
asana.description: Advanced arm balance — body suspended with legs extended forward over arms.
asana.instructions: Stand wide, fold forward, thread arms under legs, place palms behind heels, sit on upper arms, lift and extend legs. Hold 10–20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder/hamstring injury. Warm up thoroughly; advanced pose — learn under teacher.

asana.name: Fish Pose
asana.description: Supine backbend supported on forearms with crown arched back.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, slide hands under hips, lift chest, arch back, lower crown to floor (or top of head). Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury, migraine, insomnia. Use rolled blanket support under back.
benefits: Opens chest & throat, stretches front body, relieves shoulder tension, traditionally counters Shoulderstand.

asana.name: Fish with Lotus Legs
asana.description: Fish pose in lotus legs.
asana.instructions: From Fish, fold legs into lotus. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/neck injury. Master Fish and Lotus first.

asana.name: Five Animals Qigong
asana.description: Chinese qigong imitating 5 animals (tiger, deer, bear, monkey, bird).
asana.instructions: Practice 5 animal movements in sequence, 15–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Flying Heart Opener
asana.description: Base on back, flyer on base's feet in backbend.
asana.instructions: Base lies back, feet on flyer's hips, lifts flyer into backbend, flyer's arms free. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/back injury. Use spotter. Learn from teacher.
benefits: Opens flyer's chest, base strengthens legs, builds trust.

asana.name: Flying Lizard
asana.description: Lizard with back leg lifted, body hovering.
asana.instructions: From Lizard, shift weight forward, lift back leg, lower chest onto upper arms. Hold 15 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Use blocks under forearms.
benefits: Strengthens arms, opens hips, builds arm-balance strength.

asana.name: Flying Pigeon
asana.description: Arm balance with one leg in pigeon shape, body lifted.
asana.instructions: From standing, place right ankle on left thigh (Pigeon leg), bend forward, place hands on floor, lift back leg. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/hip injury, pregnancy. Master Crow first.
benefits: Strengthens arms, opens hips, improves balance.

asana.name: Forearm Plank
asana.description: Seated in chair — accessible for limited mobility, seniors, office yoga. Based on Forearm Plank.
asana.instructions: From Forearm Plank: From seated position in chair, modify pose. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury. Modify with knees down. Generally safe for all mobility levels.
benefits: deeper than full Plank. Improves accessibility
supports those who cannot get to floor.

asana.name: Forearm Stand
asana.description: Balancing on forearms, body vertical.
asana.instructions: From Dolphin, walk feet in, kick up one leg, then both legs vertical. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/neck injury, high BP, pregnancy, glaucoma. Learn near wall.

asana.name: Four-Limbed Staff
asana.description: Low-plank position — body parallel to floor, elbows at 90°.
asana.instructions: From Plank, exhale lower halfway, elbows hugged to ribs at 90°, body in straight line. Hold 1–3 breaths.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy. Drop knees to modify.

asana.name: Front Kick
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Front Kick (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Front Kick (Karate): Chamber knee, kick forward with ball of foot. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip/knee injury. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Front Stance
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Front Stance (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Front Stance (Karate): Step forward, deep lunge, back leg straight. Hold 30 sec each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: hip opener Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.name: Full Practice Sequence
asana.description: Complete balanced yoga sequence.
asana.instructions: Warm-up → Sun Salutations → Standing → Seated → Backbends → Twists → Inversions → Cool down → Savasana. 60–90 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify as needed.

asana.name: Full Wheel
asana.description: Full backbend with hands and feet on floor, body arched up.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, hands beside head fingers toward shoulders, feet flat, press up to full backbend. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder/back injury, pregnancy, high BP. Warm up first.
benefits: Opens entire front body, strengthens spine, energizes.

asana.name: Galavasana
asana.description: Crow with one leg hooked over arm, other extended back.
asana.instructions: From standing pigeon, place hands, hook leg over arm, lift other leg. Hold 10 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Ganesha Mudra
asana.description: Elephant god mudra — hands clasped with palms out, pulled apart.
asana.instructions: Clasp hands (palms out), pull apart against resistance. Hold 5 min, switch top hand.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Opens chest, releases tension, traditional for heart.

asana.name: Garland Pose
asana.description: Deep squat with feet together, hands in prayer at heart.
asana.instructions: Squat feet hip-width, palms together at heart, elbows press into inner knees. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use blanket under heels if they lift.

asana.name: Garuda Mudra
asana.description: Eagle mudra — thumbs hooked, fingers spread.
asana.instructions: Cross thumbs, hook together, spread fingers wide, hold in front of chest. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Gentle Sun Salutation
asana.description: Gentler sun salutation without chaturanga.
asana.instructions: Tadasana → Uttanasana → Lunge → Down Dog → Knees-chest-chin → Cobra → Down Dog → Lunge → Uttanasana → Tadasana. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Glute Bridge
asana.description: Glute activation exercise.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, knees bent, lift hips. 15 reps.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Goddess Pose
asana.description: Wide squat with toes turned out, arms in cactus.
asana.instructions: Stand feet wide, toes turned out 45°, bend knees to squat, thighs parallel to floor, arms in cactus. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury, low BP. Modify with shallower squat.
benefits: Opens hips, strengthens legs, opens chest, builds stamina.

asana.name: Golden Rooster Stands on One Leg
asana.sanskrit: Golden Rooster Stands on One Leg
asana.description: Tai chi balance pose on one leg.
asana.instructions: Stand on one leg, lift other thigh, hands in position. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use support.

asana.name: Grasp Sparrow's Tail
asana.description: Tai chi foundational movement.
asana.instructions: Step, ward off, roll back, press, push. Sequence.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Grasshopper
asana.description: Grasshopper with extended leg.
asana.instructions: From Grasshopper, extend top leg. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Grasshopper Pose
asana.description: Twisting arm balance with one leg extended.
asana.instructions: From lizard twist, place hands, lift back leg, extend top leg. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy. Advanced.
benefits: Strengthens arms, twists spine, opens hips.

asana.name: Half Boat Pose
asana.description: Boat pose with knees bent, shins parallel to floor.
asana.instructions: From Boat pose, bend knees, shins parallel to floor, arms forward. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low back injury, hernia, pregnancy.
benefits: Strengthens core, prepares for full boat, builds foundation.

asana.name: Half Bound Angle
asana.description: Bound angle with one leg extended.
asana.instructions: From Staff, bend right knee, place right foot on left inner thigh. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury. Use blanket under sit bones.
benefits: Opens one hip, stretches hamstrings on extended side, prepares for full version.

asana.name: Half Bow Pose
asana.description: Bow pose holding one ankle at a time.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, reach back with right hand, hold right ankle, lift chest and right thigh. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/shoulder injury, pregnancy.
benefits: Asymmetric backbend, prepares for full Bow.

asana.name: Half Butterfly
asana.description: Seated forward fold with one leg extended.
asana.instructions: Sit, one leg extended, other foot to inner thigh, fold forward. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hamstring injury. Use bolster.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings, lower back, opens one hip.

asana.name: Half Frog
asana.description: Forearm stand with one leg bent like frog.
asana.instructions: From Forearm Stand, bend one knee, foot toward same-side glute. Hold 15 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, high BP, glaucoma.
benefits: Opens hips, strengthens shoulders, prepares for advanced inversions.

asana.name: Half Garland
asana.description: Half squat with one foot on opposite thigh.
asana.instructions: Squat, place right foot on left thigh (half lotus), hands in prayer. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury. Use wall support.
benefits: Opens one hip, improves balance, stretches hip flexors.

asana.name: Half Locust
asana.description: Locust lifting one leg at a time.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, lift right leg, then left, alternating. Hold 15 sec each, repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/neck injury, pregnancy.
benefits: Strengthens back, prepares for full Locust, isolates one side.

asana.name: Half Lord of the Fishes
asana.description: Sitting spinal twist with one knee bent over the other.
asana.instructions: Sit legs extended, bend right knee, cross right foot outside left thigh, twist right, left elbow outside right knee. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, recent abdominal surgery, pregnancy (use gentle version).
benefits: Increases spinal rotation, stimulates digestion, detoxifies organs, opens shoulders.

asana.name: Half Lotus
asana.description: Preparatory lotus with one foot on opposite thigh.
asana.instructions: From Easy pose, place right foot on left thigh, left foot under right thigh. Hold 1–3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Don't force — work gradually.
benefits: Opens hips, prepares for full lotus, steadies body for meditation.

asana.name: Half Lotus Forward Bend
asana.description: Standing forward fold with one leg in half lotus.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, place right foot in half lotus, fold forward. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Don't force half lotus.

asana.name: Half Monkey
asana.description: Halfway into splits — front leg extended.
asana.instructions: From low lunge, extend front leg, fold over it. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury. Use blocks.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings, prepares for full Hanuman.

asana.name: Half Moon Pose
asana.description: Balancing pose on one leg with one hand down and the other reaching up.
asana.instructions: From Triangle, bend front knee, place lower hand on floor or block 12 inches ahead of front foot, lift back leg parallel to floor, top arm to ceiling. Hold 20–30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, headache, migraine, neck injury (gaze forward). Use block under hand.
benefits: Strengthens legs and glutes, improves balance, opens chest & hips, stretches hamstrings.

asana.name: Half Moon with Bind
asana.description: Half moon with one hand to floor, other holding ankle.
asana.instructions: From Half Moon, reach back hand to lifted ankle. Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/hip injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Half Shoulderstand
asana.description: Easier shoulderstand with legs at 45°.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, lift legs to 45°, support lower back with hands. Hold 30 sec – 2 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, glaucoma.
benefits: Gentle inversion, prepares for full Shoulderstand, supports lymph drainage.

asana.name: Half Standing Forward Bend
asana.description: Halfway lift from forward fold with flat back.
asana.instructions: From Uttanasana, lift torso parallel to floor, hands to shins or floor, lengthen spine. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury (use hands on thighs).
benefits: Stretches spine, prepares for deeper forward folds, strengthens back.

asana.name: Half Wheel
asana.description: Bridge pose lifting higher with hands under back.
asana.instructions: From Bridge, lift higher, walk hands closer to shoulders. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/wrist injury.
benefits: Opens chest, strengthens back, prepares for full wheel.

asana.name: Handstand
asana.description: Balancing on hands, body vertical.
asana.instructions: From short down-dog facing wall, kick up one leg, then both legs to vertical. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, high BP, glaucoma, pregnancy. Learn with wall and teacher.

asana.name: Happy Baby
asana.description: Supine pose holding feet, knees open toward armpits.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, draw knees toward armpits, hold outsides of feet, gently pull down. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy (after first trimester), knee/hip injury, neck injury.

asana.name: Head Clock
asana.description: Feldenkrais head awareness exercise.
asana.instructions: Sit, move head around imaginary clock. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cervical injury. Move gently.

asana.name: Head-to-Knee
asana.description: Head-to-knee with strap.
asana.instructions: From Janu Sirsasana, use strap around extended foot. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hamstring injury.

asana.name: Head-to-Knee Pose
asana.description: Asymmetric forward fold — one leg extended, the other bent.
asana.instructions: From Staff, bend right knee out, sole to inner left thigh. Hinge forward over extended leg. Hold 1–2 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury (use support), back injury, diarrhea.

asana.name: Headstand
asana.description: King of asanas — balancing on crown of head with forearms in tripod.
asana.instructions: From forearms-and-knees, clasp hands, crown of head between palms, walk feet in, lift legs slowly. Hold 30 sec – 5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/spine injury, high BP, glaucoma, heart conditions, pregnancy, menstruation, obesity. Learn under qualified teacher.
benefits: Improves circulation to brain, calms mind, builds focus, strengthens shoulders & core

asana.name: Heart Bench
asana.description: Bolster along spine, opening chest.
asana.instructions: Place bolster along spine from head to lower back, knees bent or straight. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury. Use neck pillow.
benefits: Opens chest, heart opener, restorative backbend.

asana.name: Heart-Centered Meditation
asana.description: Focus on heart center, gratitude.
asana.instructions: Sit, hand on heart, focus on heartbeat, cultivate gratitude. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Opens heart, reduces stress, gratitude practice.

asana.name: Hero Pose
asana.description: Kneeling pose sitting between heels.
asana.instructions: Kneel, knees together, feet apart wider than hips, sit back between heels. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use blanket/block under sit bones.

asana.name: Heron Pose
asana.description: Seated pose with one leg extended upward.
asana.instructions: From Dandasana, bend right knee, hold right foot, extend leg up. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hamstring injury. Use strap.

asana.name: Hip Circles
asana.description: Standing or on hands and knees, circle hips.
asana.instructions: From all fours or standing, circle hips in large slow circles. 10 each direction.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Hip Series
asana.description: Series of hip-opening poses.
asana.instructions: Butterfly → Dragon → Sleeping Swan → Shoelace sequence. 5 min each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury. Use props.
benefits: Comprehensive hip opening, prepares for meditation.

asana.name: Hip Warm-up
asana.description: Series of hip openers.
asana.instructions: Hip circles → butterfly → figure-4 → lunges. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Hissing Breath
asana.description: Cooling breath through teeth.
asana.instructions: Sit, expose teeth, inhale through teeth with hissing sound, exhale through nose. 10–15 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cold weather, dental sensitivity.

asana.name: Hollow Body Hold
asana.description: Gymnastics foundational core hold.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, lower back pressed, legs and arms lifted. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, hernia.
benefits: Builds gymnastic-style core strength, prepares for inversions.

asana.name: Holotropic Breathwork
asana.description: Stanislav Grof's intense breathwork.
asana.instructions: Breathe rapidly and deeply with music for 1–2 hours. Always with facilitator.
asana.precautions: Psychiatric conditions, pregnancy, heart disease — avoid. Always facilitated.

asana.name: Hook Kick
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Hook Kick (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Hook Kick (Karate): Chamber side, hook heel across. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Horse Pose
asana.description: Wide squat with arms extended forward at shoulder height, palms open.
asana.instructions: From Goddess, extend arms forward, palms open, gaze forward. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury, low BP.
benefits: Strengthens legs, opens hips, builds focus, stamina.

asana.name: Horse Stance
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Horse Stance (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Horse Stance (Karate): Stand wide, toes forward, sink hips. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Hridaya Mudra
asana.description: Heart mudra — hand on heart.
asana.instructions: Sit, right hand over heart. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Humble Warrior
asana.description: Warrior I with hands clasped behind back, chest folding inside front leg.
asana.instructions: From Warrior I, interlace hands behind back, fold forward inside front leg, lift clasped hands overhead. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, high BP, dizziness.
benefits: Opens shoulders, stretches hamstrings, builds focus and surrender.

asana.name: Humming Breath with Arms
asana.description: Bee breath with arm movement (Shanmukhi mudra).
asana.instructions: From Bhramari, hands in Shanmukhi mudra (closing eyes, ears, nose, mouth). 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in ear infection. Practice gently.
benefits: Deeper calming, withdraws senses, enhances meditation.

asana.name: Hundred
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Hundred (Pilates).
asana.instructions: From Hundred (Pilates): Lie supine, lift legs and head, pulse arms 100 times.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, pregnancy (after 1st trimester). Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Inchworm
asana.description: Walking hands out to plank and back.
asana.instructions: Walk hands out to plank, walk feet to hands. 5 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/hamstring injury.

asana.name: Inner Smile
asana.description: Taoist meditation of smiling inwardly.
asana.instructions: Sit, smile inwardly to each organ. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Iron Shirt Qigong
asana.description: Qigong for body conditioning.
asana.instructions: Standing postures with breath retention. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Advanced. Learn under qualified teacher.

asana.name: Jalandhara Bandha
asana.description: Chin lock — chin to chest.
asana.instructions: Sit, inhale, lower chin to chest (throat lock). Hold for breath retention.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cervical spine injury, high BP, glaucoma.

asana.name: Jewish Hitbodedut
asana.description: Jewish Hasidic solitary prayer.
asana.instructions: Speak to God aloud in private. 30 min – 1 hour daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Jnana Mudra
asana.description: Hand gesture — like Chin but palms up.
asana.instructions: Sit, hands on knees palms up, thumb and index finger touch, others extended. Hold during meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Wisdom mudra, calms, opens to receiving knowledge.

asana.name: Joint Freeing Series
asana.description: Series of joint rotations.
asana.instructions: Rotate all joints: ankles, knees, hips, spine, shoulders, elbows, wrists, neck. 10–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Move gently.

asana.name: Jump Squat
asana.description: Plyometric squat with jump.
asana.instructions: Squat, jump explosively, land soft. 10 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Kaki Mudra
asana.description: Crow's beak — lips pursed like crow.
asana.instructions: Purse lips like a crow's beak, inhale through small opening. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Kapalabhati - Kriya Form
asana.description: Skull-shining breath as a cleansing kriya.
asana.instructions: Sit, forceful exhalations (1–2/sec), 30–60 sec rounds. 3 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, epilepsy, recent abdominal surgery.

asana.name: Kapalabhati Variations
asana.description: Skull-shining breath variations in tempo.
asana.instructions: Try slow Kapalabhati (1 exhale/sec), medium (2/sec), fast (3/sec). 30 sec rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, epilepsy, recent abdominal surgery.
benefits: Different effects — slow for cleansing, fast for energy.

asana.name: Karnapidasana
asana.description: Plow pose with knees by ears.
asana.instructions: From Plow, bend knees, bring knees toward ears alongside head. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, pregnancy, high BP, ear infections.
benefits: Deep spinal stretch, opens ears/nasal passages (traditional), advanced plow variation.

asana.name: Kevala Kumbhaka
asana.description: Spontaneous breath cessation in deep meditation.
asana.instructions: Occurs naturally in deep meditation; not practiced actively.
asana.precautions: Generally safe — state rather than practice.
benefits: State of advanced meditation, natural breath pause.

asana.name: Khechari Mudra
asana.description: Tongue rolled back into throat.
asana.instructions: Roll tongue back and up into soft palate. Hold during meditation.
asana.precautions: Avoid forcing. Advanced practice.
benefits: Calms, traditional tantric practice, controls thirst/hunger.

asana.name: Kick with Right Heel
asana.description: Tai chi heel kick.
asana.instructions: Shift weight, kick with heel. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip/knee injury.

asana.name: King Pigeon
asana.description: Full pigeon backbend with backbend and foot to head.
asana.instructions: From Pigeon, bend back knee, reach back with both hands, hold back foot, bring foot to head. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/back/knee injury, pregnancy. Advanced — warm up first.
benefits: Deep hip opener + backbend, opens shoulders, advanced posture.

asana.name: Kirtan
asana.description: Devotional call-and-response chanting.
asana.instructions: Sing devotional mantras in group. 1–2 hours.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Knee Strike
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Knee Strike (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Knee Strike (Karate): Drive knee upward or forward. 10 reps each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Knee-to-Arm Plank
asana.description: Plank bringing one knee to same-side or opposite arm.
asana.instructions: From Plank, draw right knee to right arm, hold, switch. Hold 15 sec each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist injury. Modify with forearms.

asana.name: Knees-to-Chest
asana.description: Lying supine, drawing both knees to chest.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, draw both knees to chest, hold with hands, gently rock side to side. Hold 1–2 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy (after first trimester), recent abdominal surgery.
benefits: Relieves lower back, massages abdomen, aids digestion, calming.

asana.name: Knife Hand Block
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Knife Hand Block (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Knife Hand Block (Karate): From front stance, block with knife hand. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Knife Hand Strike
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Knife Hand Strike (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Knife Hand Strike (Karate): Strike with knife edge of hand. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Koshas
asana.description: Five sheaths of consciousness.
asana.instructions: Contemplate five koshas: Annamaya, Pranamaya, Manomaya, Vijnanamaya, Anandamaya.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Koundinyasana I
asana.description: Arm balance with one leg extended back, other over arm.
asana.instructions: From twist, place hands, lift legs into split position. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Koundinyasana II
asana.description: Side arm balance with both legs extended.
asana.instructions: From side lunge, place hands, lift both legs to one side. Hold 10 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Ksepana Mudra
asana.description: Releasing mudra — hands clasped, index fingers pointing down.
asana.instructions: Clasp hands, index fingers together pointing down. Hold 5–10 min, then release.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Kundalini Meditation
asana.description: Awakening Kundalini energy.
asana.instructions: Various kriyas combining breath, mantra, mudra. Traditionally under teacher.
asana.precautions: Avoid without qualified teacher. Risk of psychological issues.

asana.name: Kung Fu Bow Stance
asana.description: Kung fu bow stance.
asana.instructions: Step forward, deep lunge, back leg straight. Hold 30 sec each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Kung Fu Horse Stance
asana.description: Kung fu horse stance.
asana.instructions: Stand wide, sink hips, hands at sides. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Kurma Mudra
asana.description: Turtle mudra — thumbs tucked into palm.
asana.instructions: Tuck thumbs into palms, fold fingers over. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: L-sit
asana.description: L-shaped seated balance on hands.
asana.instructions: From seated, place hands beside hips, lift legs to L-shape. Hold 10–20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Use blocks under hands.

asana.name: Laghu Shankha Prakshalana
asana.description: Short conch cleansing — gentler version.
asana.instructions: Drink 6 glasses warm saline, perform asanas, repeat as needed.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision. Pregnancy, ulcers, hernia, kidney disease.

asana.name: Legs-on-Chair
asana.description: Lie supine with legs resting on chair.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, place lower legs on chair seat, knees bent 90°. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Restorative inversion, relieves tired legs, calms.

asana.name: Legs-up-Wall
asana.description: Legs-up-wall held long.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, legs vertical against wall. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, neck injury.

asana.name: Legs-up-the-Wall
asana.description: Restorative inversion — legs vertical against a wall, torso on floor.
asana.instructions: Sit sideways to wall, swing legs up, lie back, hips close to wall, arms out. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, neck injury, high BP. Safe for most people including pregnancy (with approval).
benefits: Relieves tired legs, mild inversion benefits, calms nervous system, reduces insomnia, anxiety.

asana.name: Linga Mudra
asana.description: Phallic mudra — thumbs up, fingers interlaced.
asana.instructions: Interlace fingers, thumbs extended upward, touching. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in summer, Pitta aggravation, fever.
benefits: Generates heat, traditional for cold weather, weight loss (traditional).

asana.name: Lion's Breath
asana.description: Forceful exhalation with tongue out, like a lion.
asana.instructions: Kneel, inhale through nose, exhale forcefully through mouth with tongue extended, gaze upward. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. May feel silly — that's the point.
benefits: Releases tension in face, throat, voice

asana.name: Lizard Pose
asana.description: Deep low lunge with both forearms on the floor inside front foot.
asana.instructions: From down-dog, step right foot outside right hand, lower forearms to floor or blocks. Hold 1–3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury, hip labral tear. Use blocks under forearms.
benefits: prepares for hip openers and arm balances.

asana.name: Locust
asana.description: Locust with one leg lifted.
asana.instructions: From Locust, lift right leg only. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Locust Pose
asana.description: Prone back extension lifting legs, head and chest.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, arms beside body, lift head, chest, arms and legs on inhalation. Hold 15–30 sec, repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/neck injury, pregnancy, recent abdominal surgery, hernia.

asana.name: Lolasana
asana.description: Body lifted in cross-legged position.
asana.instructions: From Easy pose, place hands beside hips, lift body off floor. Hold 5–15 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Use blocks under hands.

asana.name: Lord of the Dance Pose
asana.description: Standing backbend balancing on one leg, holding the back foot.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, bend right knee, hold right foot behind, kick foot into hand, lean forward, extend left arm forward. Hold 20–30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, knee/shoulder injury, severe back injury. Use strap if can't reach foot.
benefits: Improves balance, strengthens legs, opens shoulders, full-body stretch.

asana.name: Lord of the Fishes
asana.description: Full seated spinal twist — classic Hatha Yoga pose.
asana.instructions: From seated, bend left knee, heel near right hip, right foot over left thigh, twist to right, left arm outside right knee. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, recent abdominal surgery, pregnancy. Twist gently, from base of spine.
benefits: Increases spinal mobility, stimulates digestion, tones abdominal organs, relieves back pain.

asana.name: Lotus Forward Fold
asana.description: Standing forward fold in full lotus.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, fold into lotus, hold feet, fold forward. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Master Lotus first. Advanced.

asana.name: Lotus Pose
asana.description: Classical meditation pose with feet on opposite thighs.
asana.instructions: From Staff, bend right knee, cradle foot, place on left thigh; repeat with left. Sit tall, hands in chin mudra. Hold 1–10+ min.
asana.precautions: Avoid with knee or ankle injury (use Half Lotus or Sukhasana). Forceful entry risks meniscus injury.
contraindications: Knee or ankle injury — prefer Sukhasana/Ardha Padmasana
benefits: Stable, symmetrical seat for pranayama and meditation

asana.name: Loving-Kindness
asana.description: Cultivating loving-kindness toward self and others.
asana.instructions: Sit, silently repeat: 'May I be happy, may I be well, may I be at peace.' Extend to others. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Increases compassion, positive emotions, reduces anger.

asana.name: Loving-Kindness Extended
asana.description: Extended metta practice.
asana.instructions: Extend loving-kindness to self, loved ones, neutral, difficult, all beings. 20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Low Cobra
asana.description: Baby cobra with elbows bent, gentle backbend.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, palms under shoulders, elbows bent close to body, lift chest gently. Hold 15 sec, repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, back injury, carpal tunnel.
benefits: Strengthens spine, opens chest, prepares for full cobra.

asana.name: Lower Lift
asana.description: Pilates lower abdominal exercise.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, lift legs 90°, lower slowly. 10 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Lunge
asana.description: Functional walking lunge.
asana.instructions: Step forward, lower back knee, return. 10 each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Macrocosmic Orbit
asana.description: Qigong larger energy circulation.
asana.instructions: Advanced microcosmic orbit with additional channels.
asana.precautions: Advanced. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Magic Circle
asana.description: Pilates resistance ring exercises.
asana.instructions: Use resistance ring for various exercises. 10–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Maha Bandha
asana.description: Great lock — all three bandhas together.
asana.instructions: Exhale fully, apply Jalandhara (chin lock), Uddiyana (abdominal), Mula (root). Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, glaucoma, hernia. Advanced — supervised.
benefits: Combines Mula, Uddiyana, Jalandhara. Advanced spiritual practice.

asana.name: Maha Bheda Mudra
asana.description: Great piercing mudra — variation of Maha Mudra with chin lock.
asana.instructions: From Maha Mudra, apply Jalandhara Bandha (chin lock). Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, glaucoma, pregnancy. Advanced — supervised.

asana.name: Maha Mudra
asana.description: Great mudra — seated forward fold with one leg extended, holding foot.
asana.instructions: From Janu Sirsasana, hold extended foot, apply bandhas, breath retention. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, hernia. Advanced — supervised.
benefits: Combines asana, pranayama, bandha. Traditional for spiritual awakening.

asana.name: Manduki Mudra
asana.description: Frog face mudra — tongue up, eyes up.
asana.instructions: Sit, tongue to upper palate, eyes gaze up between brows. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in eye conditions. Practice gently.

asana.name: Manduki Mudra Breath
asana.description: Frog-face breath with tongue up.
asana.instructions: Sit, tongue to upper palate, inhale fully, hold, exhale. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in throat infection. Generally gentle.

asana.name: Mantra Meditation
asana.description: Meditation with sacred sound repetition.
asana.instructions: Sit, silently or aloud repeat chosen mantra (Om, So Ham, etc.). 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Meridian Yoga
asana.description: Holds targeting meridian lines.
asana.instructions: Hold poses targeting liver, kidney, spleen meridians. 3–5 min each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn under teacher for meridian specifics.
benefits: Stimulates acupressure meridians, traditional Chinese medicine.

asana.name: Metta
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Metta (Loving-Kindness).
asana.instructions: From Metta (Loving-Kindness): Silently repeat: 'May I be happy, may I be well.' Extend to others. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: reduces anger Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.name: Microcosmic Orbit
asana.description: Qigong energy circulation through meridians.
asana.instructions: Sit, tongue to palate, circulate energy up back down front. 20–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Mindful Breathing
asana.description: Simple awareness of breath.
asana.instructions: Sit, observe breath at nostrils or belly, return when mind wanders. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Mindfulness Meditation
asana.description: Awareness of present moment without judgment.
asana.instructions: Sit comfortably, focus on breath, observe thoughts without attachment, return to breath. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Trauma-sensitive considerations.
benefits: Reduces stress, anxiety, improves focus, emotional regulation, well-being.

asana.name: Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction
asana.description: Jon Kabat-Zinn's 8-week MBSR program.
asana.instructions: Body scan, mindful breathing, mindful movement. 45 min daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Trauma-informed modifications.

asana.name: Modified Sun Salutation
asana.description: Sun salutation modified for pregnancy.
asana.instructions: Standing side stretches, no prone poses, wide stance. 3–5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Avoid prone poses after 1st trimester.

asana.name: Monkey Pose
asana.description: Full front splits pose.
asana.instructions: From low lunge, slide front leg forward, back leg back, into full splits. Hold 1–3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring/hip injury. Use blocks under hands, blanket under back knee.
benefits: Deep hip and hamstring stretch, traditional.

asana.name: Moon Piercing Breath
asana.description: Cooling breath inhaling through left nostril (Ida).
asana.instructions: Sit, close right nostril, inhale through left, exhale through right. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Avoid in cold weather with congestion.
benefits: Cools body, calms, traditional for Pitta, sleep aid.

asana.name: Moon Salutation
asana.description: Cooling sequence, moon-energy.
asana.instructions: Series of lateral poses: side stretches, triangle, side lunge. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Mountain Climber
asana.description: Plank with alternating knee drives.
asana.instructions: From plank, drive knees to chest alternately. 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist injury.

asana.name: Mountain Pose
asana.description: Foundation standing pose; the blueprint for all standing asanas.
asana.instructions: Stand feet together, weight even, lift arches, engage thighs, lengthen spine, roll shoulders back, arms by sides, gaze forward. Hold 30–60 sec.

benefits: Improves posture and body alignment awareness

asana.name: Mula Bandha
asana.description: Root lock — pelvic floor contraction.
asana.instructions: Sit, contract pelvic floor (perineum). Hold 30 sec – 1 min. Release.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, severe pelvic pain.
benefits: Awakens energy, supports core, traditional tantric.

asana.name: Murchha Pranayama
asana.description: Fainting breath — long exhale with chin lock.
asana.instructions: Inhale, hold breath, chin to chest (Jalandhara Bandha), exhale slowly. 5 rounds.

benefits: Calms mind deeply, induces relaxed state (traditional).

asana.name: Nabho Mudra
asana.description: Tongue to upper palate.

asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms, prepares for Khechari, basic tongue mudra.

asana.name: Nadi Shodhana with Kumbhaka
asana.description: Alternate nostril breath with retention.
asana.instructions: Inhale left, hold 4 counts, exhale right; inhale right, hold 4, exhale left. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, heart disease, pregnancy. Don't strain retention.
benefits: Deeper balancing, builds lung capacity, advanced practice.

asana.name: Nasika Mudra
asana.description: Hand gesture for pranayama — ring and pinky alternately close nostrils.
asana.instructions: Right hand, index and middle fingers curled, use thumb and ring finger to alternate. Use in pranayama.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Used for Nadi Shodhana and other pranayama.

asana.name: Native American Vision Quest
asana.description: Native American solitary quest for vision.
asana.instructions: Solitary time in nature, fasting, seeking vision. Traditional.
asana.precautions: Only with traditional guidance; safety considerations.

asana.name: Nauli
asana.description: Isolation and churning of abdominal muscles.
asana.instructions: Stand, exhale fully, isolate rectus abdominis muscles, churn. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, hernia, ulcers. Empty stomach only.

asana.name: Neck Pull
asana.description: Pilates roll-up with hands behind head.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, hands behind head, roll up to seated. 5 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury.

asana.name: Neck Warm-up
asana.description: Gentle neck movements.
asana.instructions: Slow neck rotations, side-to-side, forward-back. 3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cervical injury. Move very gently.
benefits: Releases neck tension, prepares for asanas.

asana.name: Needle at Sea Bottom
asana.description: Tai chi forward bend.
asana.instructions: From wide stance, bend forward with extended arm. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, low BP.

asana.name: Neti
asana.description: Nasal cleansing with saline through one nostril, out other.
asana.instructions: Use Neti pot with saline, pour through one nostril, out other. Daily or as needed.
asana.precautions: Use boiled/cooled water only, correct saline. Avoid in severe deviated septum, infection.
benefits: Clears nasal passages, reduces sinusitis, traditional Hatha practice.

asana.name: Niyamas
asana.description: Five observances: Saucha, Santosha, Tapas, Svadhyaya, Ishvara Pranidhana.
asana.instructions: Practice purity, contentment, discipline, self-study, surrender in daily life.
asana.precautions: Generally safe — ethical practice.

asana.name: Noose Pose
asana.description: Deep squat twist — arms bound around knees.
asana.instructions: Squat feet together, twist right, left arm around both knees, right arm behind back, clasp hands. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury, low back injury, pregnancy. Use wall support.
benefits: Deep spinal twist, opens shoulders, stretches ankles, stimulates digestion.

asana.name: OM Chanting
asana.description: Chanting OM primordial sound.
asana.instructions: Chant OM aloud or silently, feel vibration. 5–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: OM Meditation
asana.description: Meditation on OM sound.
asana.instructions: Sit, chant OM aloud or silently, feel vibration. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: One-Legged Crow
asana.description: Crow with one leg extended back.
asana.instructions: From Crow, extend one leg back, hold, switch. Hold 10 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy. Master Crow first.

asana.name: One-Legged Wheel
asana.description: Wheel pose with one leg lifted.
asana.instructions: From Wheel, lift one leg up. Hold 15 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/wrist injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Open Leg Rocker
asana.description: Pilates rolling like a ball with open legs.
asana.instructions: Sit, hold ankles, legs open, roll back and up. 6 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury.

asana.name: Padma Mudra
asana.description: Lotus mudra — hands forming lotus shape.
asana.instructions: Bring palms together, spread fingers like lotus petals, base of palms touch. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Part the Wild Horse's Mane
asana.description: Tai chi movement resembling horse mane parting.
asana.instructions: Step and turn, hands in opposing circles. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Partner Backbend
asana.description: Partners stand back-to-back, link arms, fold forward.
asana.instructions: Stand back-to-back, link arms, one partner folds forward lifting other. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/shoulder injury. Communicate.

asana.name: Partner Boat
asana.description: Sitting facing, holding hands, both in boat pose.
asana.instructions: Sit facing partner, hold hands, lift legs to touch feet together. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury. Communicate.

asana.name: Partner Breathing
asana.description: Synchronized breathing back-to-back.
asana.instructions: Sit back-to-back, breathe together, feel each other's breath. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Partner Cat-Cow
asana.description: Cat-cow synchronized with partner.
asana.instructions: Sit back-to-back, synchronize cat-cow breathing. Flow 1–2 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Partner Forward Fold
asana.description: Two partners facing, holding hands, folding forward.
asana.instructions: Stand facing partner, hold hands, both fold forward, gently pull. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury. Communicate intensity.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings, deepens forward fold with partner's pull.

asana.name: Partner Hip Opener
asana.description: Partners assist each other in pigeon.
asana.instructions: Partner A in pigeon, partner B gently presses A's hip down. Hold 1 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Communicate. Avoid in knee injury.
benefits: Deeper hip opening with partner support.

asana.name: Partner Seated Twist
asana.description: Partners seated facing, twisting opposite directions.
asana.instructions: Sit facing, legs interlaced, twist in opposite directions. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Communicate. Avoid in spinal injury.

asana.name: Partner Shoulder Opener
asana.description: Partners assist in shoulder stretches.
asana.instructions: Partner A kneeling arms back, partner B gently lifts A's arms. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Communicate. Avoid in shoulder injury.

asana.name: Partner Stretch Side
asana.description: Partners sit facing, one stretches side, other assists.
asana.instructions: Sit facing, partner A side-bends, partner B gently pulls A's arm overhead. 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Communicate intensity. Avoid in shoulder injury.
benefits: Deepens side body stretch with partner help.

asana.name: Partner Tree Pose
asana.description: Standing side-by-side, both in tree.
asana.instructions: Stand side-by-side, inner arms around waist, both tree pose. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use partner for balance.

asana.name: Partner Twist
asana.description: Seated back-to-back, twisting in opposite directions.
asana.instructions: Sit back-to-back, twist right as partner twists left. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury. Move gently.
benefits: Deepens spinal twist with partner resistance.

asana.name: Pashinee Mudra
asana.description: Folded pose — Plow with hands clasped around feet.
asana.instructions: From Plow, reach hands around to clasp feet. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, pregnancy, high BP.

asana.name: Pelvic Clock
asana.description: Feldenkrais pelvic awareness exercise.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, imagine clock on pelvis, move slowly around hours. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Pelvic Floor Exercises
asana.description: Kegel exercises for pelvic floor.
asana.instructions: Squeeze pelvic floor muscles (like stopping urine), hold 5 sec, release. 10–20 reps 3×/day.
asana.precautions: Generally safe throughout pregnancy.
benefits: Strengthens pelvic floor, prepares for childbirth.

asana.name: Pelvic Tilts
asana.description: Gentle pelvic tilts on hands and knees.
asana.instructions: From table-top, tilt pelvis forward and back gently. 10 reps.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Eases back pain, prepares pelvis for childbirth.

asana.name: Pigeon
asana.description: King pigeon with deeper backbend.
asana.instructions: From King Pigeon, deepen backbend. Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/hip injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Pigeon Pose
asana.description: Deep hip opener and backbend — front leg in figure-4, back leg extended.
asana.instructions: From down-dog, slide right knee toward right wrist, extend left leg back, square hips, fold forward or lift chest. Hold 1–3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/sacrum injury (use blanket under hip). Stop if knee pain. Use blocks/support.
benefits: Opens hips, stretches psoas, releases emotional tension, improves posture, prepares for deeper backbends.

asana.name: Pigeon with King Variation
asana.description: King pigeon variation.
asana.instructions: From King Pigeon, reach both hands to back foot. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/back/hip injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Pigeon with Strap Bind
asana.description: Pigeon with strap holding back foot.
asana.instructions: From Pigeon, use strap around back foot, hold with both hands. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/back injury.
benefits: Builds toward King Pigeon with strap support.

asana.name: Pincha Mayurasana
asana.description: Forearm stand — body vertical on forearms.
asana.instructions: From Dolphin, walk feet in, kick up one leg, then both vertical. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, high BP, glaucoma, pregnancy. Use wall initially.

asana.name: Plank
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Plank (Functional).
asana.instructions: From Plank (Functional): Hold plank position 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist injury. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: full-body stability Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.instructions: From down-dog, shift forward until shoulders over wrists, body in straight line, engage core. Hold 30–60 sec.

asana.name: Plavini Pranayama
asana.description: Floating breath — swallowing air into stomach.
