benefits: Traditional: creates feeling of lightness, reduces hunger (not for casual practice).

asana.name: Plow Pose
asana.description: Supine pose — legs overhead, toes to floor behind head.
asana.instructions: From Shoulderstand, lower legs overhead, toes to floor behind head, hands on back or extended. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, diarrhea, menstruation, pregnancy (advanced), high BP. Use support under shoulders.
benefits: Stretches spine & shoulders, stimulates thyroid, calms brain, relieves fatigue & backache.

asana.name: Prana Mudra
asana.description: Life-force mudra — thumb touching ring and pinky.
asana.instructions: Touch thumb to ring and pinky fingertips, others extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Pranayama Bhramari
asana.description: Bee breath with humming.
asana.instructions: Close ears, inhale, exhale with humming sound. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Pranayama Kapalabhati
asana.description: Skull-shining breath.
asana.instructions: Forceful exhales (1–2/sec), passive inhale. 30–60 sec rounds, 3×.
asana.precautions: Pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, epilepsy — avoid.

asana.name: Pranayama Nadi Shodhana
asana.description: Alternate nostril breathing.
asana.instructions: Close one nostril, inhale; switch, exhale. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't force breath.

asana.name: Pranayama Practice
asana.description: Fourth limb — breath control.
asana.instructions: Practice pranayama techniques daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe with guidance.

asana.name: Pranayama Rest
asana.description: Rest pose before/after pranayama.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, arms relaxed, observe breath. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms nervous system, prepares for breathwork.

asana.name: Pranayama Ujjayi
asana.description: Victorious breath with throat constriction.
asana.instructions: Constrict throat slightly, breathe through nose with audible 'ha' sound. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid forcing breath, jaw tension.

asana.name: Pratiloma Pranayama
asana.description: Inhale through alternate nostrils, exhale through both.
asana.instructions: Inhale through one nostril (alternate), exhale through both. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe nasal congestion.

asana.name: Pratyahara
asana.description: Fifth limb — withdrawal of senses.
asana.instructions: Practice sense withdrawal during meditation.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Withdraws senses from external, prepares for meditation.

asana.name: Press
asana.description: Tai chi pressing movement.
asana.instructions: Step forward, press with both hands. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Prithvi Mudra
asana.description: Earth mudra — thumb touching ring finger.
asana.instructions: Touch thumb to ring fingertip, others extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Punch
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Punch (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Punch (Karate): From stance, punch with lead or rear hand. 10 reps each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Puppy Pose
asana.description: Half-dog with hips over knees, chest melting toward floor.
asana.instructions: From table-top, walk hands forward, lower chest toward floor, hips over knees. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury. Use bolster under chest.

asana.name: Push
asana.description: Tai chi pushing movement.
asana.instructions: Step forward, push with both hands. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Pyramid Pose
asana.description: Intense side stretch with one foot forward, deep forward fold over the front leg.
asana.instructions: Stand feet 3 ft apart, right foot forward, square hips, hinge forward over front leg, hands to floor/shins. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, high BP, hamstring tear. Bend front knee if hamstrings tight.

asana.name: Raised Arms Pose
asana.description: Mountain pose with arms raised overhead.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, raise arms overhead, palms facing each other, lengthen spine, gaze slightly up. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, high BP, headache. Modify with shoulder-width arms.
benefits: Stretches shoulders, opens chest, improves digestion, warms up the body.

asana.name: Rebirthing Breathwork
asana.description: Connected breathing for emotional release.
asana.instructions: Continuous circular breathing without pause. 1 hour with facilitator.
asana.precautions: Strong emotions can surface. Work with facilitator.

asana.name: Reclined Bound Angle
asana.description: Bound angle pose lying on back, optionally with bolster.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, bend knees, soles together, knees fall open, arms relaxed. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury (use blocks under thighs), pregnancy (use bolster support).

asana.name: Reclined Hero
asana.description: Reclined hero pose — lying back between feet.
asana.instructions: From Hero pose, recline back onto forearms or fully to floor. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use bolster along spine. Don't force.

asana.name: Reclined Pigeon
asana.description: Supine hip stretch with one ankle on opposite thigh.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, bend knees, cross right ankle over left thigh, thread hands behind left thigh, draw toward chest. Hold 1–2 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Modify by holding back of thigh less deeply.
benefits: Opens outer hip, stretches glutes, safer for knees than full Pigeon.

asana.name: Reclined Twist
asana.description: Supine twist held long.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, drop bent knees to one side, arms out. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury.

asana.name: Reformer Footwork
asana.description: Pilates reformer footwork.
asana.instructions: On reformer, push platform with feet in various positions. 10 reps each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe with instructor.

asana.name: Reformer Hundred
asana.description: Pilates hundred on reformer.
asana.instructions: On reformer, arms press straps, 100 pulses.
asana.precautions: Generally safe with instructor.

asana.name: Reformer Knee Stretch
asana.description: Pilates knee stretch on reformer.
asana.instructions: On reformer, knees bent, push and pull platform.
asana.precautions: Generally safe with instructor.

asana.name: Reformer Short Spine
asana.description: Pilates short spine massage on reformer.
asana.instructions: On reformer, lift legs overhead, articulate spine down.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury. Use instructor.

asana.name: Repulse Monkey Variation
asana.description: Variation of repulse monkey.
asana.instructions: Step back, push with both hands. 5 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Reverse Plank
asana.description: Full reverse plank — body straight, hands under shoulders.
asana.instructions: From Reverse Tabletop, extend legs straight, body in straight line. Hold 20–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury.
benefits: Strengthens entire back body, opens chest, stretches front.

asana.name: Reverse Tabletop
asana.description: Supine backbend with hands behind hips, body lifted reverse-tabletop shape.
asana.instructions: Sit, hands behind hips fingers forward, feet hip-width flat, lift hips to reverse tabletop. Hold 20–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury. Use full Reverse Plank (Purvottanasana) progression if ready.
benefits: Strengthens glutes, hamstrings, upper back, triceps

asana.name: Reverse Warrior
asana.description: Warrior II variation with backbend and one hand down the back leg.
asana.instructions: From Warrior II, lower back hand to back leg, lift front arm overhead, gaze up. Hold 20–30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury (gaze forward), low BP, balance issues. Slide hand lightly down leg, don't push.
benefits: Stretches side body, opens chest, strengthens legs, energizes.

asana.name: Revolved Chair Pose
asana.description: Chair pose with spinal twist, hands in prayer.
asana.instructions: From Chair, hands in prayer at heart, twist right, left elbow outside right knee. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, low BP, knee injury. Keep knees aligned.
benefits: Twists spine, strengthens legs, stimulates digestion.

asana.name: Revolved Half Moon
asana.description: Half moon with spinal twist.
asana.instructions: From Ardha Chandrasana, twist torso, opposite hand to floor. Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, balance issues.

asana.name: Revolved Side Angle
asana.description: Twisting deep lunge with hands in prayer at heart or arms extended.
asana.instructions: From low lunge, twist toward front knee, opposite elbow outside front knee, hands in prayer. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, low BP, knee injury. Modify with back knee down.
benefits: Twists spine, opens hips, strengthens legs, stimulates abdominal organs.

asana.name: Revolved Triangle
asana.description: Standing twist with one hand to floor and the other extended upward.
asana.instructions: From Triangle base, twist torso opposite side, opposite hand to floor outside front foot, other arm to ceiling. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/spinal injury, low BP, migraine. Use block under hand if tight.
benefits: Strengthens and twists spine, stretches legs, opens chest, improves balance & digestion.

asana.name: Roll Back
asana.description: Tai chi yielding movement.
asana.instructions: Step back, sweep arm down. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Roll Up
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Roll Up (Pilates).
asana.instructions: From Roll Up (Pilates): Lie supine, arms overhead, slowly roll up to seated, return. 5–10 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in disc injury, osteoporosis. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Roundhouse Kick
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Roundhouse Kick (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Roundhouse Kick (Karate): Pivot, chamber knee, kick horizontally with instep. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Saddle
asana.description: Reclined hero pose held long.
asana.instructions: From kneeling, sit between heels, recline back onto bolster. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use bolster along spine.

asana.name: Sahajoli Mudra
asana.description: Urogenital contraction (female).
asana.instructions: Sit, contract urogenital muscles (like Kegel). Hold 5 sec, release. 10–20 reps.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't over-tighten.
benefits: Strengthens pelvic floor, traditional tantric, female reproductive.

asana.name: Sahita Kumbhaka
asana.description: Intentional breath retention with inhalation/exhalation.
asana.instructions: Inhale fully, hold 4 counts, exhale fully, hold 2 counts. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, heart disease, pregnancy. Don't strain.
benefits: Calms, builds lung capacity, prepares for advanced pranayama.

asana.name: Sama Vritti
asana.description: Equal inhale and exhale counts.
asana.instructions: Inhale 4 counts, exhale 4 counts. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Calms, balances nervous system, focuses mind.

asana.name: Samadhi
asana.description: Eighth limb — absorption.
asana.instructions: Outcome of regular practice, not actively practiced.
asana.precautions: Generally safe — state.

asana.name: Sandhana Pranayama
asana.description: Meditation breath with mantra.
asana.instructions: Inhale with silent mantra, hold, exhale with mantra. 10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn under teacher.
benefits: Deepens meditation, focuses mind, traditional tantric practice.

asana.name: Satsang
asana.description: Spiritual discourse and meditation.
asana.instructions: Attend satsang with teacher, meditation, discourse. 1–2 hours.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Savasana
asana.description: Final relaxation pose.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, arms and legs relaxed, eyes closed. Hold 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use props for comfort.

asana.name: Savasana with Bolster
asana.description: Savasana with bolster under knees.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, bolster under knees, arms relaxed. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Saw
asana.description: Pilates seated twist.
asana.instructions: Sit legs apart, twist to each side reaching pinky to opposite foot. 6 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in disc injury.

asana.name: Scale Pose
asana.description: Body lifted from Lotus pose on hands.
asana.instructions: From Lotus, place hands beside hips, lift body. Hold 5–15 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/knee injury. Master Lotus first.

asana.name: Scissors
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Scissors (Pilates).
asana.instructions: From Scissors (Pilates): Lie supine, lift legs, scissor alternately. 10 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury. Modify for beginner modification.
benefits: hamstring flexibility Adapted for beginner modification.

asana.name: Scorpion Pose
asana.description: Forearm stand with feet toward head.
asana.instructions: From Forearm Stand, bend knees, feet toward head. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/shoulder/neck injury, high BP, pregnancy. Very advanced.

asana.name: Seal Pose
asana.description: Deeper prone backbend on hands.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, hands under shoulders, press up, gaze up. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, back/wrist injury.

asana.name: Seated Cat-Cow
asana.description: Seated in chair — accessible for limited mobility, seniors, office yoga. Based on Seated Cat-Cow.
asana.instructions: From Seated Cat-Cow: From seated position in chair, modify pose. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe spinal injury. Generally safe for all mobility levels.
benefits: Warms spine, releases tension, gentle on wrists. Improves accessibility
supports those who cannot get to floor.

asana.name: Seated Flow
asana.description: Flowing seated sequence.
asana.instructions: Dandasana → Staff → Bound Angle → Forward fold → Twist → Boat. Repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Seated Forward Bend
asana.description: Classic seated forward fold over extended legs.
asana.instructions: From Staff, inhale arms up, exhale hinge forward from hips, hold shins/feet, lengthen spine. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, hernia, diarrhea. Bend knees if hamstrings tight.
contraindications: Herniated disc / sciatica — avoid deep spinal flexion
Asthma — keep chest elevated on a bolster
benefits: Calms the nervous system when held passively
Traditional forward fold for prana grounding

asana.name: Seated Spinal Twist
asana.description: Seated in chair — accessible for limited mobility, seniors, office yoga. Based on Seated Spinal Twist.
asana.instructions: From Seated Spinal Twist: From seated position in chair, modify pose. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, pregnancy. Generally safe for all mobility levels.
benefits: Releases spine, stimulates digestion, opens shoulders. Improves accessibility
supports those who cannot get to floor.

asana.name: Sensing the Spine
asana.description: Feldenkrais spinal awareness.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, scan spine, move segment by segment. 10–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Shankha Prakshalana
asana.description: Conch cleansing — full GI tract cleanse with saline water.
asana.instructions: Drink warm saline water, perform specific asanas, repeat until clear water passes. Half-day process.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision. Strict diet after. Pregnancy, ulcers, hernia, kidney disease.

asana.name: Shanmukhi Mudra
asana.description: Six-gated mudra — closing eyes, ears, nose, mouth with fingers.
asana.instructions: Hands on face: thumbs close ears, index fingers over eyes, middle on nose bridge, ring/pinky on mouth corners. Hold during Bhramari.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Practice gently.

asana.name: Shiva Linga Mudra
asana.description: Shiva phallus mudra — right hand vertical, left hand cupped.
asana.instructions: Cup left hand, right thumb up in left palm. Hold 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Shoelace
asana.description: Seated with legs stacked like shoelace.
asana.instructions: Sit, stack right knee over left, feet toward hips, fold forward. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury. Use props generously.
benefits: Deep outer hip stretch, opens glutes.

asana.name: Shoulder Bridge
asana.description: Pilates bridge with leg lift.
asana.instructions: From bridge, lift one leg vertical, lower. 6 reps each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury.

asana.name: Shoulder Clock
asana.description: Feldenkrais shoulder awareness exercise.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, imagine clock on shoulders, move alternately. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Shoulder Stroke
asana.description: Tai chi shoulder movement.
asana.instructions: Step and strike with shoulder. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Shoulder Warm-up
asana.description: Shoulder mobility exercises.
asana.instructions: Shoulder rolls → arm circles → strap stretches. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Shoulderstand
asana.description: Full-body inversion on shoulders, legs vertical.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, lift legs and hips to vertical, support lower back with hands, balance on shoulders & upper arms. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, high BP, glaucoma, menstruation, pregnancy (beyond first trimester). Use folded blankets under shoulders.
benefits: Stimulates thyroid & parathyroid, improves circulation, calms brain, drains lymph, traditionally rejuvenating.

asana.name: Side Crow
asana.description: Twisting variation of Crow — knees stacked on one upper arm.
asana.instructions: From squat, twist torso, place knees on outer right upper arm, shift weight, lift feet. Hold 10–20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy. Master Crow first.

asana.name: Side Kick
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Side Kick (Karate).
asana.instructions: From Side Kick (Karate): Chamber knee to side, extend heel outward. 10 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Side Plank
asana.description: One-arm side plank — body sideways on one hand and outer foot.
asana.instructions: From Plank, shift weight to right hand, stack left foot on right, lift left arm to ceiling. Hold 20–30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/elbow/shoulder injury. Modify with bottom knee down.

asana.name: Side Plank Variations
asana.description: Side plank with top leg lifted or arm extended.
asana.instructions: From Side Plank, lift top leg, or reach top arm under body (thread the needle). Hold 15 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/wrist injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Side-Lying Corpse
asana.description: Corpse pose lying on left side, supported.
asana.instructions: Lie on left side, pillow between knees, bolster under belly. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use props for comfort.
benefits: Safe relaxation pose for late pregnancy, supports blood flow.

asana.name: Side-Lying Savasana
asana.description: Side-lying relaxation pose.
asana.instructions: Lie on left side, pillow between knees, bolster under belly. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Always lie on left side after 1st trimester.

asana.name: Silent Sitting
asana.description: Practice of silence.
asana.instructions: Sit silently, observe, no speaking. 30 min – extended periods.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Single Leg Kick
asana.description: Pilates prone leg kick.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, kick one heel to glute at a time. 8 reps each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Single Leg Stretch
asana.description: Pilates core exercise alternating legs.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, draw one knee to chest, other extended, alternate. 10 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury.

asana.name: Single Whip
asana.description: Classic tai chi posture; single hand 'whip'.
asana.instructions: Step forward, hook one hand, push with other. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sinking Qi
asana.description: Qigong meditation sinking energy to lower dantian.
asana.instructions: Sit or stand, focus on lower abdomen, breathe deeply. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sitali Variations
asana.description: Cooling breath with variations.
asana.instructions: Try Sitali with different counts (4-4-4, 4-6-4). 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cold weather, respiratory infection.

asana.name: Sitkari Variations
asana.description: Cooling breath through teeth with variations.
asana.instructions: Try Sitkari with different counts (4-4-4, 4-6-4). 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cold weather, dental sensitivity.

asana.name: Six Healing Sounds
asana.description: Qigong of 6 healing sounds for organs.
asana.instructions: Practice 6 sounds for liver, heart, spleen, lungs, kidneys, triple heater. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Skull-Shining Breath
asana.description: Energetic cleansing breath — forceful exhalations, passive inhalations.
asana.instructions: Sit tall, inhale deeply, then short forceful exhales through nose (1–2 per sec), passive inhale. 30–60 sec rounds, 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, epilepsy, recent abdominal surgery, severe asthma.
benefits: Energizes, clears nasal passages, tones abdomen, improves digestion, sharpens mind.

asana.name: Sky Gazing
asana.description: Gazing at open sky.
asana.instructions: Sit outdoors facing open sky, soft gaze, rest in awareness. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sleep Meditation
asana.description: Guided meditation for sleep.
asana.instructions: Lie in bed, follow guided meditation for sleep (body scan, breath, visualization). 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sleeping Pigeon
asana.description: Pigeon with torso folded forward over front leg.
asana.instructions: From Pigeon, fold torso forward over front shin, rest forehead on floor/block. Hold 1–3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury, sacrum pain. Use bolster under torso.
benefits: Releases hip flexors, psoas, emotional tension

asana.name: Sleeping Swan
asana.description: Pigeon pose held long for deep hip release.
asana.instructions: From Pigeon, fold forward over front shin, hold 3–5 min. Switch sides.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Use bolster under torso and hip.
benefits: Opens hips, stretches psoas, releases emotional tension.

asana.name: Snail
asana.description: Plow pose held long for spine stretch.
asana.instructions: From supine, lift legs overhead to floor behind, hold 2–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, high BP, glaucoma. Use support.

asana.name: Snake Creeps Down
asana.description: Tai chi low stance.
asana.instructions: Lower into deep lunge, hands in position. Hold 30 sec each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Modify depth.

asana.name: So Ham Meditation
asana.description: Meditation on 'I am That' breath-mantra.
asana.instructions: Sit, inhale silently 'So', exhale silently 'Ham'. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sound Bath
asana.description: Sound bath meditation with singing bowls.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, listen to singing bowls, gongs. 30–60 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sound Bath / Nada Yoga
asana.description: Meditation on inner/outer sound.
asana.instructions: Sit, listen to outer sound (singing bowl, gong), then inner sound. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sphinx
asana.description: Gentle prone backbend on forearms.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, forearms on floor, lift chest. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, back injury.
benefits: Gentle backbend, opens chest, supports lower back.

asana.name: Sphinx Pose
asana.description: Gentle prone backbend on forearms.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders, lift chest, gaze forward. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, back injury, carpal tunnel.
benefits: Gentle backbend, opens chest, supports lower back, restorative.

asana.name: Spinal Warm-up
asana.description: Series of spinal movements.
asana.instructions: Cat-cow → side bends → gentle twists → backbends. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Move gently.
benefits: Mobilizes spine in all directions, prepares for asanas.

asana.name: Spine Corrector
asana.description: Pilates with spine corrector barrel.
asana.instructions: Use spine corrector for backbends, forward folds, side stretches.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury.

asana.name: Spine Series
asana.description: Series of spinal movements.
asana.instructions: Caterpillar → Sphinx → Seal → Snail → Twist sequence. 3–5 min each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/neck injury. Move gently.
benefits: Stretches entire spine in all directions.

asana.name: Spine Twist
asana.description: Pilates seated spinal twist.
asana.instructions: Sit legs extended, twist side to side with arms out. 8 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury.

asana.name: Square
asana.description: Seated with legs crossed in figure-4.
asana.instructions: Sit, right ankle on left thigh, fold forward. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Use blocks under thighs.
benefits: Deep hip opener, stretches outer hips.

asana.name: Squat
asana.description: Foundational functional movement.
asana.instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width, lower hips, keep chest up. 10–20 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Modify depth.

asana.name: Squat / Garland
asana.description: Deep squat for hip opening.
asana.instructions: Stand wide, squat down (use wall for support), hands in prayer. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in symphysis pubis dysfunction (SPD). Use wall.
benefits: Opens hips, prepares for childbirth, eases back.

asana.name: Staff Pose
asana.description: Foundation seated pose — legs extended, spine upright like a staff.
asana.instructions: Sit legs extended, feet flexed, hands beside hips pressing down, spine long, chest open. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low back injury (sit on folded blanket). Hamstring tight: bend knees slightly.
benefits: Strengthens back, stretches hamstrings, improves posture, foundation for all seated asanas.

asana.name: Standing Backbend
asana.description: Gentle standing backbend, hands on lower back.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, hands on lower back, lift chest, lean back, gaze up. Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck/back injury, low BP, dizziness.
benefits: Opens chest, shoulders, stretches abs, prepares for deeper backbends.

asana.name: Standing Big Toe Hold
asana.description: Standing balance holding big toe, extending leg forward or side.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, lift right knee, hold big toe with right hand, extend leg forward, then side. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury, low BP, balance issues. Use strap if can't reach toe.
benefits: Strengthens legs, improves balance, stretches hamstrings.

asana.name: Standing Cat-Cow
asana.description: Cat-cow flow while standing.
asana.instructions: Stand hands on thighs, inhale arch (Cow), exhale round (Cat). Flow 1 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Standing Flow
asana.description: Flowing sequence of standing poses.
asana.instructions: Tadasana → Uttanasana → Plank → Up Dog → Down Dog → Warrior I → Warrior II → Triangle → Side Angle. Repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Standing Forward Bend
asana.description: Deep standing forward fold from hips.
asana.instructions: Stand feet hip-width, hinge forward from hips, let head hang, hands to floor or shins. Bend knees if needed. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury (bend knees), hernia, recent abdominal surgery, low BP (rise slowly).
benefits: Calms brain, relieves stress & mild depression

asana.name: Standing Forward Bend Holding Wrists
asana.description: Forward fold holding opposite wrists behind legs.
asana.instructions: From Uttanasana, hold opposite wrists behind calves. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, low BP.

asana.name: Standing Forward Bend with Hands Clasped
asana.sanskrit: Standing Forward Bend with Hands Clasped
asana.description: Standing forward fold with hands clasped behind back.
asana.instructions: From Uttanasana, interlace hands behind back, fold forward. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, low BP.

asana.name: Standing Half Bound Lotus
asana.description: Standing with one leg in half lotus, hand behind back.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, place right foot on left thigh, reach right hand behind back to foot. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/shoulder injury. Use strap.
benefits: Opens hip and shoulder, prepares for full Lotus.

asana.name: Standing Half Moon
asana.description: Seated in chair — accessible for limited mobility, seniors, office yoga. Based on Standing Half Moon.
asana.instructions: From Standing Half Moon: From seated position in chair, modify pose. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, headache, migraine, neck injury. Use block under hand. Generally safe for all mobility levels.
benefits: Strengthens legs and glutes, opens chest, improves balance, stretches side body. Improves accessibility
supports those who cannot get to floor.

asana.name: Standing Hand-to-Big-Toe
asana.description: Standing balance with one leg extended to the side, holding big toe.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, hold right big toe, extend right leg to side, gaze left. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip/hamstring injury, low BP. Use strap.
benefits: Strengthens legs, improves balance, opens hips.

asana.name: Standing Hand-to-Foot
asana.description: Extended hand-to-foot pose.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, hold big toe, extend leg fully forward, then side. Hold 20 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury, balance issues.

asana.name: Standing Knee-to-Nose
asana.description: From down dog, draw knee to nose.
asana.instructions: From down dog, lift right leg, draw knee to nose on exhale. Repeat 5×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist injury. Modify with forearms.

asana.name: Standing Pigeon
asana.description: Standing balance with one ankle on opposite thigh, hips back.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, lift right foot to left thigh, sit back like chair, hands in prayer. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury, balance issues. Use wall.
benefits: Opens outer hip, improves balance, stretches glutes.

asana.name: Standing Pigeon Fold
asana.description: Standing figure-4 forward fold.
asana.instructions: From standing figure-4, fold forward over crossed leg. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hamstring injury.

asana.name: Standing Pigeon Fold Twist
asana.description: Standing pigeon with twist.
asana.instructions: From standing figure-4, fold forward, then twist. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/hip injury.

asana.name: Standing Side Bend
asana.description: Side bend with one arm overhead.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, raise right arm overhead, side-bend left. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Standing Side Stretch
asana.description: Gentle side stretch standing.
asana.instructions: Stand, raise one arm overhead, side-bend gently. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Generally safe in pregnancy.
benefits: Opens side body, eases round-ligament pain.

asana.name: Standing Split
asana.description: Forward fold on one leg with the other leg extended upward.
asana.instructions: From Uttanasana, lift right leg up behind, both hands to floor or hold right ankle. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury, low BP, balance issues. Use blocks under hands.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings, strengthens standing leg, improves balance.

asana.name: Standing Split Backbend
asana.description: Standing split with backbend.
asana.instructions: From Standing Split, reach back with opposite hand, arch spine. Hold 15 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/hamstring injury. Advanced.

asana.name: Standing Split with Bind
asana.description: Standing split holding ankle with both hands.
asana.instructions: From Uttanasana, lift right leg, hold right ankle with both hands, draw leg up. Hold 20 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hamstring injury, low BP.

asana.name: Standing Twist
asana.description: Simple standing twist with crossed legs.
asana.instructions: Cross right leg over left, twist right. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury.

asana.name: Step Back to Repulse Monkey
asana.description: Tai chi backward stepping.
asana.instructions: Step back, push with opposite hand. 5 reps each side.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sudarshan Kriya
asana.description: Art of Living's signature breath technique.
asana.instructions: Cyclical breathing in specific rhythms. 30–45 min daily.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn under teacher.

asana.name: Sufi Dhikr
asana.description: Sufi repetition of divine names.
asana.instructions: Repeat sacred phrases silently or aloud, often with breath. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Sun Piercing Breath
asana.description: Warming breath inhaling through right nostril (Pingala).
asana.instructions: Sit, close left nostril, inhale through right, exhale through left. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in Pitta aggravation, summer, fever. High BP caution.
benefits: Warms body, stimulates, energizes, traditional for Vata/Kapha.

asana.name: Sun Salutation A
asana.description: Classical Ashtanga sun salutation.
asana.instructions: Tadasana → Uttanasana → Half Uttanasana → Plank → Chaturanga → Up Dog → Down Dog → Jump forward → Uttanasana → Tadasana. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, pregnancy (modify).

asana.name: Sun Salutation B
asana.description: Ashtanga B series with Warrior I.
asana.instructions: Surya A + Warrior I variations. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder/knee injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Sun Salutation C
asana.description: Vinyasa variation with Anjaneyasana.
asana.instructions: Surya A + low lunge variations. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Modify knee.

asana.name: Sun Salutation with Mantras
asana.description: Sun salutation with 12 Surya mantras.
asana.instructions: 12 rounds, each with specific Surya mantra. Traditionally at sunrise.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Learn mantras.

asana.name: Superman Pose
asana.description: Prone pose lifting arms and legs like flying.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, extend arms forward, lift arms, chest, legs. Hold 15–30 sec, repeat 3×.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back/neck injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Supine Twist
asana.description: Lying spinal twist with one knee crossed over the body.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, draw right knee to chest, cross it to left side, extend right arm out, gaze right. Hold 1–3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe spinal injury, recent abdominal surgery. Move gently, support knee with bolster.

asana.name: Supported Bound Angle
asana.description: Bound angle with bolster along spine.
asana.instructions: Sit, soles together, place bolster behind spine, recline onto bolster. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury (use blocks under thighs).
benefits: Opens chest, restorative hip opener, gentle.

asana.name: Supported Bridge
asana.description: Bridge pose with block under sacrum.
asana.instructions: From Bridge, place block under sacrum, rest hips on block. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury. Use lowest block height to start.
benefits: Gentle backbend, restorative chest opener, calms nervous system.

asana.name: Supported Child's Pose
asana.description: Child's pose with bolster between knees.
asana.instructions: From Child's pose, place bolster between knees, rest torso on bolster. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Deep restorative, releases hips and back.

asana.name: Supported Pigeon
asana.description: Pigeon with bolster under torso.
asana.instructions: From Pigeon, place bolster under torso, rest fully. Hold 3 min each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Supported Shoulderstand
asana.description: Shoulderstand with blankets under shoulders for neck safety.
asana.instructions: Stack 2–3 blankets, head off blanket, shoulders on, lift to shoulderstand. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, glaucoma. Always use blankets.
benefits: Same benefits as Shoulderstand, safer for neck.

asana.name: Supported Twist
asana.description: Supine twist with bolster supporting knees.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, knees stacked on bolster to one side, arms extended. Hold 3 min each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury. Move gently.
benefits: Gentle spinal twist, releases lower back.

asana.name: Surya Mudra
asana.description: Sun mudra — thumb over ring finger knuckle.
asana.instructions: Fold ring finger to base of thumb, thumb over knuckle. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in Pitta aggravation, summer.
benefits: Generates heat, traditional for weight loss, Vata reduction.

asana.name: Sutra Neti
asana.description: Nasal cleansing with thread.
asana.instructions: Insert soft thread through nostril, pull out mouth, gently pull back and forth. Traditional.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision — risk of nasal tissue damage.
benefits: Deeper nasal cleansing than jalneti, traditional.

asana.name: Swan
asana.description: Pilates swan — prone backbend.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, press up to backbend, lower. 6 reps.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, pregnancy.

asana.name: Tai Chi
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Tai Chi (Hao Style).
asana.instructions: From Tai Chi (Hao Style): Practice Hao-style form under teacher.
asana.precautions: Advanced; learn under teacher. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Tai Sabaki
asana.description: Aikido body movement.
asana.instructions: Practice pivoting and stepping in various directions. 10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Therapeutic Bridge
asana.description: Bridge pose with support.
asana.instructions: From supine, knees bent, lift hips, block under sacrum. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use block support.
benefits: Strengthens back, opens chest, with support.

asana.name: Therapeutic Cat-Cow
asana.description: Gentle spinal mobility flow.
asana.instructions: From table-top, gentle cat-cow. Flow 2–3 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Move gently.
benefits: Eases back pain, mobilizes spine, gentle.

asana.name: Therapeutic Child's Pose
asana.description: Child's pose with bolster.
asana.instructions: From kneeling, fold over bolster between knees. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use bolster.

asana.name: Therapeutic Flying
asana.description: Base lifts flyer in decompression pose.
asana.instructions: Base on back, feet on flyer's hips, lifts flyer forward, flyer's spine stretches. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/back injury. Use spotter.

asana.name: Therapeutic Hip Series
asana.description: Series of gentle hip openers.
asana.instructions: Reclined pigeon → happy baby → bound angle sequence. 1–2 min each.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Use props.
benefits: Eases hip tension, low back pain.

asana.name: Therapeutic Legs-on-Wall
asana.description: Legs-up-wall with support.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, legs vertical against wall. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Avoid in glaucoma.

asana.name: Therapeutic Neck Stretches
asana.description: Gentle neck stretches seated.
asana.instructions: Sit, gently tilt head right, left, forward, backward. 30 sec each direction.
asana.precautions: Avoid in cervical spine injury. Move very gently.

asana.name: Therapeutic Pigeon
asana.description: Supported pigeon with bolster.
asana.instructions: From pigeon, place bolster under torso, rest fully. Hold 3 min each side.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Use props.

asana.name: Therapeutic Reclined Twist
asana.description: Gentle supine twist with support.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, knees to one side with bolster, arms out. Hold 3 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Move gently.

asana.name: Therapeutic Shoulder Openers
asana.description: Gentle shoulder stretches with strap.
asana.instructions: Sit, hold strap overhead, move arms forward/back. 10 reps.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Therapeutic Sphinx
asana.description: Gentle sphinx pose for back care.
asana.instructions: Lie prone, forearms on floor, lift chest gently. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, back injury acute.
benefits: Strengthens back, gentle backbend, supports lower back.

asana.name: Third Eye Meditation
asana.description: Focus on third eye (between eyebrows).
asana.instructions: Sit, close eyes, gaze inward/upward between eyebrows. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, eye pressure. Practice gently.

asana.name: Three-Part Breath
asana.description: Full yogic breath filling belly, ribs, chest.
asana.instructions: Lie or sit, inhale fill belly, then ribs, then chest; exhale reverse. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't strain.
benefits: Increases lung capacity, calms, full oxygenation, foundational for pranayama.

asana.name: Thunderbolt
asana.description: Thunderbolt with arms overhead.
asana.instructions: From Thunderbolt, raise arms overhead. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Thunderbolt Pose
asana.description: Kneeling pose sitting on heels.
asana.instructions: Kneel, knees together, sit back on heels, hands on thighs. Hold 1–5 min, or 5 min after meals.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee/ankle injury. Use cushion under sit bones.
benefits: Improves digestion, meditation pose, can be done after meals.

asana.name: Tibetan Tonglen
asana.description: Tibetan breathing in suffering, breathing out relief.
asana.instructions: Inhale suffering, exhale relief/compassion. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Can be emotionally challenging. Trauma-informed guidance.

asana.name: Tittibhasana
asana.description: Firefly with different arm positions.
asana.instructions: From Firefly, try different arm positions. Hold 10 sec each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury.

asana.name: Tittibhasana Variations
asana.description: Firefly pose variations — legs wide, arms supporting.
asana.instructions: Various Firefly variations — legs higher, body lower, etc.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder/hamstring injury.
benefits: Strengthens arms, opens hips, stretches hamstrings.

asana.name: Toe Squat
asana.description: Seated in chair — accessible for limited mobility, seniors, office yoga. Based on Toe Squat.
asana.instructions: From Toe Squat: From seated position in chair, modify pose. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in toe/foot injury, plantar fasciitis acute phase. Build gradually. Generally safe for all mobility levels.
benefits: supports those who cannot get to floor.

asana.name: Tonglen
asana.description: Tibetan practice of breathing in suffering, breathing out relief.
asana.instructions: Sit, inhale suffering (self/others), exhale relief/compassion. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Can be emotionally challenging. Trauma-informed guidance.

asana.name: Tongue Lock Breath
asana.description: Breath with tongue rolled back into throat.
asana.instructions: Roll tongue back and up into throat, breathe slowly. Advanced practice.
asana.precautions: Avoid forcing tongue. Advanced — supervised.

asana.name: Transcendental Meditation
asana.description: Silent mantra meditation.
asana.instructions: Sit comfortably, eyes closed, silently repeat personalized mantra. 20 min 2×/day.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Personalized mantra from TM teacher.
benefits: Reduces stress, BP, anxiety, improves cognition, traditional TM technique.

asana.name: Transformational Breath
asana.description: Connected mouth breathing.
asana.instructions: Breathe deeply through mouth without pause. 45–60 min with facilitator.
asana.precautions: Strong emotions can surface. Work with facilitator.

asana.name: Trataka
asana.description: Fixed gaze on candle or object.
asana.instructions: Light candle at eye level, gaze without blinking until eyes water. Close eyes, visualize. 10–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, severe eye conditions. Don't strain eyes.
benefits: Improves concentration, cleanses eyes, traditional for meditation.

asana.name: Trataka Meditation
asana.description: Candle gazing meditation.
asana.instructions: Light candle at eye level 2 ft away, gaze without blinking until eyes water. Close, visualize flame. 10–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in glaucoma, eye conditions. Don't strain.

asana.name: Tree Pose
asana.description: Single-leg balance resembling a steady tree.
asana.instructions: From Tadasana, shift weight to left foot. Place right sole on left inner thigh (not knee). Hands in prayer or overhead. Hold 30–60 sec, switch sides.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, migraine, severe vertigo. Use wall support if balance issues or hip/knee injury.
contraindications: Recent ankle, knee or hip injury
Vertigo or balance disorders — practice near a wall
benefits: Cultivates focus and steadiness of attention

asana.name: Triangle Pose
asana.description: Lateral standing bend forming a triangle shape.
asana.instructions: Stand wide, turn right foot out 90°. Reach right arm forward, hinge at hip, lower right hand to shin/ankle, left arm up. Gaze up. Hold 30–60 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, diarrhea, headache, neck injury (gaze forward instead of up).
contraindications: Low blood pressure — come up slowly
Late pregnancy — use wider stance and support
benefits: Stretches lateral body, hamstrings and waist

asana.name: Tripod Headstand
asana.description: Headstand with hands on floor in tripod.
asana.instructions: From Wide-Leg Forward Bend, place crown of head on floor, hands in tripod formation, lift legs. Hold 30 sec – 3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, high BP, glaucoma, pregnancy. Advanced — learn under teacher.

asana.name: Trust Fall
asana.description: Partner falls backward into other's arms.
asana.instructions: Stand back-to-wall/partner, fall back, partner catches. 3–5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Communicate clearly. Use spotter. Start low.

asana.name: Tummo
asana.description: Simplified version with props. Based on Tummo (Inner Fire).
asana.instructions: From Tummo (Inner Fire): Visualization with breath retention. Traditional.
asana.precautions: Advanced — learn under teacher. Cardiovascular caution. Modify for beginner modification.

asana.name: Turn Body and Punch
asana.description: Tai chi punch with body turn.
asana.instructions: Turn body, punch with fist. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury.

asana.name: Twisted Lizard
asana.description: Lizard with one foot outside hand, twist, reaching arm up.
asana.instructions: From Lizard, lower right shoulder toward floor, reach left arm under and up to ceiling. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/hip injury, spinal injury.
benefits: Deep hip opener with twist, opens chest, stimulates digestion.

asana.name: Twisted Roots
asana.description: Seated twist held long.
asana.instructions: Sit, cross right over left, twist right. Hold 3–5 min, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury. Gentle entry.

asana.name: Uddiyana Bandha
asana.description: Abdominal lock — exhale and draw abdomen up and back.
asana.instructions: Stand, exhale fully, draw abdomen up and back under ribs. Hold 10–15 sec. Release.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, high BP, heart disease, ulcers, hernia. Empty stomach only.
benefits: Tones abdomen, stimulates digestion, traditional energetic practice.

asana.name: Ujjayi with Kumbhaka
asana.description: Victorious breath with breath retention.
asana.instructions: Inhale Ujjayi, hold 4 counts, exhale Ujjayi, hold 2 counts. 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, heart disease, pregnancy. Don't strain.
benefits: Deeper calming, builds heat, advanced practice.

asana.name: Upward-Facing Dog
asana.description: Deep backbend with straight arms and legs lifted off floor.
asana.instructions: From prone, palms beside waist, press into hands, lift chest and thighs off floor, legs straight, gaze slightly up. Hold 15–30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/back injury, pregnancy, carpal tunnel. Modify with Cobra Pose.

asana.name: Vajroli Mudra
asana.description: Urogenital contraction (male).
asana.instructions: Sit, contract urogenital muscles (like Kegel). Hold 5 sec, release. 10–20 reps.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't over-tighten.
benefits: Strengthens pelvic floor, traditional tantric, male reproductive.

asana.name: Vaman Dhauti
asana.description: Stomach cleansing with saline water, then vomit.
asana.instructions: Drink warm saline water until full, then vomit. Traditionally on empty stomach morning.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision. Pregnancy, ulcers, hernia, GERD, eating disorders.
benefits: Cleanses stomach, traditional for Kapha disorders.

asana.name: Varada Mudra
asana.description: Boon-giving gesture — left hand lowered, palm out.
asana.instructions: Stand or sit, left hand lowered, palm forward. Hold 1–5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Varuna Mudra
asana.description: Water mudra — thumb touching pinky.
asana.instructions: Touch thumb to pinky fingertip, others extended. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Balances water, hydration, traditional for skin.

asana.name: Vastra Dhauti
asana.description: Swallowing cloth for stomach cleansing.
asana.instructions: Swallow 6-foot muslin cloth soaked in water, then slowly pull out. Traditional.
asana.precautions: Avoid without supervision. Risk of choking/internal injury.

asana.name: Vayu Mudra
asana.description: Air mudra — thumb over index finger knuckle.
asana.instructions: Fold index finger to base of thumb, thumb over knuckle. Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Reduces air (Vata), calms, traditional for joint pain.

asana.name: Victorious Breath
asana.description: Soft ocean-sounding breath created by gentle throat constriction.
asana.instructions: Sit or while practicing asanas. Constrict back of throat slightly, breathe through nose — audible soft 'ha' sound on exhale. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid forcing the breath, jaw tension, holding breath. Avoid in severe respiratory infection.
benefits: Builds internal heat, calms nervous system, enhances focus, sustains asana practice.

asana.name: Viloma Pranayama
asana.description: Interrupted breath — pauses during inhale/exhale.
asana.instructions: Inhale 1/3, pause, inhale 1/3, pause, inhale 1/3; exhale similar. 5 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't strain.
benefits: Builds lung capacity, strengthens diaphragm, calms.

asana.name: Viparita Karani Mudra
asana.description: Inversion pose with legs vertical — Viparita Karani.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, legs vertical (or against wall). Hold 5–15 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in neck injury, glaucoma.

asana.name: Vipassana
asana.description: Insight meditation — observing sensations impermanence.
asana.instructions: Body scan from head to feet, observe sensations without reaction. 10-day retreats traditional.
asana.precautions: Can surface difficult emotions. Trauma-informed guidance recommended.
benefits: Develops insight, equanimity, traditional Buddhist practice.

asana.name: Vipassana Body Scan
asana.description: Vipassana body scan for insight.
asana.instructions: Scan body head to feet, observe sensations. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Can surface difficult emotions. Trauma-informed guidance.

asana.name: Vishama Vritti
asana.description: Unequal inhale-exhale, often longer exhale.
asana.instructions: Inhale 4, exhale 6 (calming) or inhale 6, exhale 4 (energizing). 5–10 rounds.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Don't strain.

asana.name: Vishnu Mudra
asana.description: Hand gesture — index and middle finger folded, used in Nadi Shodhana.
asana.instructions: Right hand, index and middle fingers folded, thumb and ring/pinky free. Use in Nadi Shodhana.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Visualization Meditation
asana.description: Guided imagery.
asana.instructions: Sit, visualize peaceful scene or desired outcome in detail. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Walking Meditation
asana.description: Slow mindful walking.
asana.instructions: Walk slowly, focus on each footstep, breath, surroundings. 10–20 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Wall Half Handstand
asana.description: Half handstand at wall, body L-shaped.
asana.instructions: From table facing wall, walk feet up wall to hip height, body L-shaped. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, high BP.
benefits: Builds shoulder strength, prepares for full handstand.

asana.name: Wall Sit Rest
asana.description: Sit against wall, legs extended.
asana.instructions: Sit with back against wall, legs extended. Hold 3–5 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Use cushion.
benefits: Releases back, gentle inversion for legs.

asana.name: Wall Squat
asana.description: Squat with back against wall.
asana.instructions: Stand back to wall, slide down to squat. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury.

asana.name: Wall Walking Handstand
asana.description: Walk feet up wall into handstand position.
asana.instructions: From short down-dog facing wall, walk feet up wall, body vertical. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in wrist/shoulder injury, high BP.
benefits: Builds shoulder strength, prepares for handstand, inversion benefits.

asana.name: Ward Off
asana.description: Tai chi defensive posture.
asana.instructions: Step and raise arm in arc. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Warrior I
asana.description: Lunge with arms raised overhead, hips facing forward.
asana.instructions: From down-dog, step right foot forward between hands. Back foot 45°, heels hip-width. Rise arms overhead. Hold 30–60 sec, switch sides.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, heart conditions, shoulder injury (keep hands on hips). Knee issues — keep front knee less deep.
contraindications: Acute knee injury — reduce depth, keep front knee over ankle
Shoulder injury — hands on hips variant
benefits: Strengthens legs, hips and back extensors

asana.name: Warrior II
asana.description: Side-facing deep lunge with arms extended horizontally.
asana.instructions: From Warrior I, open hips and arms parallel to long side of mat. Front knee over ankle, gaze over front hand. Hold 30–60 sec, switch sides.
asana.precautions: Avoid in high BP, knee injury, diarrhea. Front knee should track over 2nd/3rd toe, not cave inward.
benefits: Strengthens legs and ankles, opens hips & chest, builds endurance, sharpens concentration.

asana.name: Warrior III
asana.description: Balancing pose forming a 'T' shape — body horizontal on one leg.
asana.instructions: From Warrior I, hinge forward, lift back leg to hip height, body parallel to floor, arms forward, alongside ears. Hold 20–30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP, severe back injury. Use wall or chair for support if balance unsteady.
benefits: Strengthens entire back body, ankles, legs

asana.name: Wave Hands Like Clouds
asana.description: Tai chi movement; flowing hand motion.
asana.instructions: Step side-to-side with flowing hand circles. 5–10 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Wheel with Block
asana.description: Wheel pose with block under sacrum for support.
asana.instructions: Place block under sacrum, lift chest, walk hands toward feet. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe with support.

asana.name: White Crane Spreads Wings
asana.description: Classic tai chi posture of crane spreading wings.
asana.instructions: Step back, raise one arm, lower other. Hold briefly.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Wide-Angle Seated
asana.description: Wide-angle with hands clasped forward.
asana.instructions: From Wide-Angle, fold forward, interlace hands, reach forward. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in hip injury.

asana.name: Wide-Angle Seated Forward Bend
asana.description: Seated with legs wide apart, folding forward.
asana.instructions: Sit legs wide (90–120°), hinge forward from hips, walk hands forward. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in back injury, hamstring tear. Sit on elevation, hands on blocks.
benefits: Opens hips, stretches hamstrings, inner thighs

asana.name: Wide-Knee Child's Pose
asana.description: Child's pose with knees wide apart.
asana.instructions: From kneeling, knees wide, big toes touching, fold forward, arms forward. Hold 1–3 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Use bolster.
benefits: Opens hips, relieves lower back, restorative for pregnancy (with widening).

asana.name: Wide-Leg Forward Bend
asana.description: Wide-stance forward fold with head moving toward floor.
asana.instructions: Stand feet wide apart, hands on hips, hinge forward with flat back, hands on floor shoulder-width, head toward floor. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in low BP (rise slowly), back injury (use hands on hips modification).
benefits: Stretches hamstrings & inner thighs, opens hips, calms brain, mild inversion benefit.

asana.name: Wide-Leg Forward Bend with Twist
asana.description: Seated in chair — accessible for limited mobility, seniors, office yoga. Based on Wide-Leg Forward Bend with Twist.
asana.instructions: From Wide-Leg Forward Bend with Twist: From seated position in chair, modify pose. Hold 30–60 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in spinal injury, low BP. Use block if hamstrings tight. Generally safe for all mobility levels.
benefits: Spinal twist, stretches hamstrings, opens chest, stimulates digestion. Improves accessibility
supports those who cannot get to floor.

asana.name: Wide-Leg Forward Fold with Bind
asana.description: Wide-leg forward fold with hands clasped behind back.
asana.instructions: From wide-leg forward fold, interlace hands behind back, fold forward. Hold 30 sec.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder injury, low BP.

asana.name: Wim Hof Method
asana.description: Wim Hof's breath + cold exposure method.
asana.instructions: 30 deep breaths, retention, then cold shower/ice bath. Daily.
asana.precautions: Pregnancy, epilepsy, heart disease — avoid breath holds.

asana.name: Wind-Relieving
asana.description: Wind-relieving with both knees alternately.
asana.instructions: Alternate right and left knee to chest, then both. 5 cycles.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy, hemorrhoids.

asana.name: Wind-Relieving Pose
asana.description: One knee to chest at a time, massaging abdomen.
asana.instructions: Lie supine, draw right knee to chest, left leg extended, hold. Switch sides, then both knees. Hold 30 sec each.
asana.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy (after 1st trimester), hernia, hemorrhoids.
benefits: Releases gas, improves digestion, massages abdominal organs, relieves lower back.

asana.name: Wings of the Butterfly
asana.description: Bound angle with knees moving up and down.
asana.instructions: From bound angle, gently flap knees up and down 1–2 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in knee injury. Move gently.

asana.name: Wrist Warm-up
asana.description: Wrist stretches for practice.
asana.instructions: Wrist circles, finger spreads, palm presses. 2 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Prevents wrist injury in weight-bearing poses.

asana.name: Yamas
asana.description: Five ethical restraints: Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha.
asana.instructions: Practice non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, moderation, non-possessiveness in daily life.
asana.precautions: Generally safe — ethical practice.
benefits: Foundation of yoga ethics, traditional Patanjali.

asana.name: Yoga Mudra
asana.description: Yogic seal — kneeling forward fold with hands behind back.
asana.instructions: Kneel, hands behind back clasped, fold forward. Hold 1 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in shoulder/knee injury. Modify hands in prayer at back.
benefits: Calms, opens chest, stretches shoulders, traditional.

asana.name: Yoga Nidra
asana.description: Guided deep relaxation lying supine.
asana.instructions: Lie supine in Savasana, follow guided Yoga Nidra. 15–30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Stay awake mentally.
benefits: Reduces stress, improves sleep, deep restoration, equivalent to hours of sleep.

asana.name: Yoga for Anxiety Sequence
asana.description: Sequence for anxiety relief.
asana.instructions: Child's pose → Cat-cow → Legs-up-wall → Nadi Shodhana → Savasana. 30 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Yoni Mudra
asana.description: Womb mudra — hands interlaced forming womb shape.
asana.instructions: Interlace fingers, thumbs and index fingers form diamond. Hold in lap. 5 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.

asana.name: Zen Meditation
asana.description: Just sitting, observing breath and posture.
asana.instructions: Sit in seiza or half-lotus, erect spine, focus on breath, observe thoughts. 20–40 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Knee discomfort possible.
benefits: Calms, develops equanimity, traditional Zen Buddhist.

asana.name: Zen Zazen
asana.description: Zen Buddhist just-sitting meditation.
asana.instructions: Sit in seiza or half-lotus, erect spine, focus on breath. 20–40 min.
asana.precautions: Generally safe. Knee discomfort possible.

asana.name: Zhan Zhuang
asana.description: Chinese standing meditation pose.
asana.instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width, knees soft, arms rounded as if hugging tree. Hold 10–30 min.
asana.precautions: Avoid in severe knee/ankle injury. Build gradually.

asana.name: supported Triangle
asana.description: Triangle pose with chair or block support.
asana.instructions: From wide stance, hand on block or chair, other arm up. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Avoid deep twists. Use support generously.

asana.name: supported Warrior II
asana.description: Warrior II with hand on chair.
asana.instructions: Warrior II with back hand on chair for balance. Hold 30 sec, switch.
asana.precautions: Generally safe.
benefits: Strengthens legs, opens hips, with support.
